F201.role: Veterinary practice controlled-drug accountable clinician, reviewing one drug's register line per audit period
F201.setting: A multi-branch small-animal and equine practice group runs a monthly controlled-drug audit. For each drug, strength and branch, the reviewer opens one record bundling the register page, the patient records that cite that drug, the physical stock count, disposal records and any approved variance exceptions. The reviewer decides whether the line can be closed, how large and of what kind any discrepancy is, and how complete the authentication is. The figures in the record are the only evidence.

unexplained_shortfall.instructions: Evidence shows an unexplained stock shortfall on this register line.

line_disposition.instructions: What should the reviewer do with this register line now?

criteria.sign_off: Line fully reconciles and every entry is properly authenticated.
criteria.correct_and_sign: Only clerical slips, fixable by dated annotation without further evidence.
criteria.hold_pending: One missing confirmation must arrive before the line can close.
criteria.escalate: Unexplained loss or unlogged removal needs a director or regulator report.

variance_cause.instructions: Which cause accounts for the largest share of the variance?

criteria.no_discrepancy: Closing count matches the register once documented adjustments are applied.
criteria.arithmetic_slip: Largest variance comes from a running balance miscalculated between entries.
criteria.unrecorded_administration: Largest variance matches clinical-record doses missing from the register.
criteria.undocumented_disposal: Largest variance matches stock removed without any register disposal entry.
criteria.unexplained_loss: Largest variance has no matching counterpart anywhere in the record.

variance_size.instructions: How large is the unreconciled variance relative to volume handled?
criteria: Nil: no variance remains after documented adjustments
Trace: remaining variance below 2% of volume handled
Material: remaining variance from 2% up to 10%
Major: remaining variance above 10% of volume handled

auth_gaps.instructions: How many register entries lack a required signature or witness?
criteria: Every entry carries all required signatures and witnesses
Exactly one entry lacks a signature or witness
Two or three entries lack a signature or witness
Four or more entries lack a signature or witness

factors.name: drug_profile
factors.description: Drug, strength and schedule of the line; sets whether administrations need a witness and the typical volumes handled.

factors.name: arithmetic_slip_count
factors.description: Number of entries whose running balance does not equal the prior balance minus or plus that entry's quantity.

factors.name: unrecorded_admin
factors.description: Volume of doses present in clinical records for this drug and period with no matching register entry.

factors.name: clinical_records_missing
factors.description: Clinical records section arrives null because the practice-management export failed, so administrations cannot be cross-checked.

factors.name: disposal_state
factors.description: Status of expired or broken stock leaving the line: none needed, witnessed and entered, entered without witness, or removed with no register entry.

factors.name: unexplained_shortfall_pct
factors.description: Shortfall of physical count against the corrected register balance that matches no clinical record, disposal or exception, as a percentage of volume handled.

factors.name: variance_exception
factors.description: Approved variance exception (breakage report or spillage sign-off) and whether it is in date and covers the full or partial shortfall.

factors.name: manufacturer_overfill
factors.description: Batch carries a documented manufacturer overfill allowance, producing a small surplus that offsets apparent shortfall or creates a benign overage.

factors.name: auth_gap_count
factors.description: Number of register entries missing the administering signature or, for drugs requiring it, the witness id.

factors.name: count_out_of_order
factors.description: Physical stock count dated before the final register entry of the period, so the count does not reflect the closing balance.

factors.name: unit_mismatch
factors.description: Clinical records state doses in mg or mcg while the register uses ml, requiring conversion via the header concentration.

factors.name: locum_signatory
factors.description: Some entries signed by a locum staff id that looks unfamiliar but appears in the branch roster for those dates.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Remaining variance placed within 0.3 percentage points of 2% or 10%, or two causes of nearly equal volume.

sections.name: register_header
sections.description: Drug, strength, concentration_mg_ml, schedule, witness_required, branch_id, page_id, period_start, period_end, opening_balance_ml.

sections.name: entries
sections.description: List of register lines: entry_id, date, type, qty_ml, patient_id, running_balance_ml, signed_by, witness_id, batch_no.

sections.name: clinical_records
sections.description: List of patient dose records: patient_id, date, dose, dose_unit, route, clinician_id; or null when export failed.

sections.name: stock_check
sections.description: Physical count: count_date, counted_ml, counted_by, checked_by, batch_no, overfill_allowance_ml.

sections.name: disposals
sections.description: List of disposal events: batch_no, qty_ml, reason_code, removed_date, register_entry_id, witness_id, denatured_date.

sections.name: exceptions
sections.description: List of approved variance exceptions: exception_id, batch_no, qty_ml, reason_code, approved_by, valid_from, valid_to.

F201.rendering_notes: drug_profile sets register_header fields including witness_required (true for schedule 2 drugs) and plausible entry volumes. arithmetic_slip_count appears only as running_balance_ml values inconsistent with the previous balance and qty_ml; the reviewer must recompute. unrecorded_admin appears as clinical_records items whose patient_id and date have no entries line; when unit_mismatch is true the dose is in mg or mcg and must be divided by concentration_mg_ml to compare, and some correctly recorded doses are also shown in mg as decoys. clinical_records_missing renders clinical_records as null; this is a single missing confirmation (hold) unless other signals escalate. disposal_state: witnessed_complete has a disposals item with register_entry_id, witness_id and denatured_date; entered_unwitnessed has register_entry_id but witness_id null (counts as a missing confirmation, not variance); removed_unlogged has a disposals item with register_entry_id null and no matching entries line, so its qty_ml sits inside the count shortfall. unexplained_shortfall_pct is realised only as stock_check.counted_ml being lower than the recomputed balance by an amount not matched by any clinical record, disposal or exception. variance_exception renders exceptions items; expired_or_other_batch has valid_to before the event or a different batch_no, so it is a decoy that must not be applied; valid_partial_cover covers only part of the shortfall. manufacturer_overfill sets stock_check.overfill_allowance_ml above zero and may produce a small count surplus that is benign. auth_gap_count renders signed_by null or, where witness_required is true, witness_id null; witness_id null is not a gap when witness_required is false (decoy). count_out_of_order sets stock_check.count_date earlier than the last entries date, making the comparison unreliable and favouring hold. locum_signatory uses a staff id format unlike the others yet valid, a decoy against escalation. Remaining variance for variance_size is the recomputed closing balance minus counted_ml, after applying valid exceptions and overfill allowance, divided by opening_balance_ml plus receipts. No field states a reconciled status, variance percentage, cause, risk level or disposition; there are no free-text fields; unknown values are null.

F202.role: Track section manager reviewing each completed track patrol report before it is closed or actioned
F202.setting: A regional rail infrastructure maintainer runs foot patrols over its plain-line track. After each patrol, the patroller files a report listing the booked section, a GPS walk trace, defects found with measurements and an assigned priority, and a short free-text comment. The track section manager reviews one report at a time. They check the defects against the response limits in the local standard and the patrol against its booking. Using site context such as existing speed restrictions, recent repairs and defect history, they decide what happens next. All organisations, routes and people are invented.

priority_supported.instructions: Recorded measurements support the priority the patroller assigned to each defect.

criteria.true: Every defect's measurement falls within its assigned priority band.
criteria.false: Any measurement missing, unit-mismatched or in another band.

next_step.instructions: What should the reviewer do with this patrol report next?

criteria.close_report: No outstanding defect exceeds limits; report needs no follow-up.
criteria.monitor_next_patrol: Outstanding defect within monitor band only; recheck at next patrol.
criteria.hold_query: Decision hinges on one unconfirmed item; query patroller first.
criteria.raise_repair: Confirmed outstanding defect beyond monitor band; book repair work.

worst_category.instructions: Which category is the report's highest-band defect, by measurement?

criteria.lineside: Vegetation, drainage, fencing or cess condition outside the track.
criteria.track_component: Fastenings, sleepers, ballast or joint components degraded or missing.
criteria.track_geometry: Twist, gauge, top or line measured beyond tolerance.
criteria.rail_integrity: Cracks, squats, breaks or head damage in the rail itself.

discrepancy_size.instructions: How far does the recorded value differ from the expected value?
criteria: Matches expected value, or differs by under 2%
Differs from expected value by 2% to under 10%
Differs from expected value by 10% to under 25%
Differs from expected value by 25% or more

response_urgency.instructions: How soon must the worst outstanding confirmed defect be attended?
criteria: No outstanding defect exceeds any listed response threshold
Exceeds monitor limit only; attend within 28 days
Exceeds seven-day limit but not the immediate limit
Exceeds immediate limit; attend within 36 hours

factors.name: measured_band
factors.description: True response band of the worst defect, judged by its measurement against the standards table

factors.name: worst_defect_category
factors.description: Category of the defect with the highest measured band

factors.name: priority_vs_measurement
factors.description: How the patroller's assigned priority relates to the measured band for at least one defect

factors.name: unit_mismatch
factors.description: A defect measurement is logged in a unit different from the standards table, e.g. inches vs mm or 1-in-N vs mm over base

factors.name: location_mismatch
factors.description: Difference between a defect's mileage and the walked range or the mileage quoted in the note

factors.name: coverage_gap_pct
factors.description: Percentage of booked mileage not covered by the GPS walk trace

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: Whether site context holds a fact that lowers concern about the worst defect

factors.name: mitigation_kind
factors.description: Form of mitigation when present

factors.name: repeat_history
factors.description: Count of earlier reports logging the same defect type within 0.05 miles

factors.name: photo_evidence
factors.description: Whether the worst defect has a photo attached

factors.name: note_stance
factors.description: How the patroller's free-text comment relates to the structured entries

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Worst measurement sits exactly on a threshold in the standards table

factors.name: decoy_alarm
factors.description: Alarming but irrelevant context such as heavy rain, high line speed or a late-running train

sections.name: patrol
sections.description: Patrol id, patroller id, date, ELR, booked start and end mileage, frequency, weather, line speed

sections.name: walk_trace
sections.description: GPS walked start and end mileage, gap list with mileages, duration in minutes

sections.name: defects
sections.description: List of defects: id, type, category, mileage, measurement, unit, assigned priority, photo flag

sections.name: site_context
sections.description: Active ESRs, worksites, recent repairs with sign-off, last geometry run, prior defect history

sections.name: standards
sections.description: Per defect type thresholds for monitor, seven-day and immediate bands with units

sections.name: remarks
sections.description: Patroller free-text comment, one to three sentences, and optional gang sign-off line

F202.rendering_notes: Every record has 1 to 4 defect entries; the worst is the highest measured band against standards (ties broken rail_integrity > track_geometry > track_component > lineside). measured_band appears only as defects[].measurement compared with standards thresholds; boundary_case puts the value exactly on a threshold, and the table never says whether limits are inclusive. priority_vs_measurement shows in defects[].priority (P1 immediate, P2 seven-day, P3 monitor, P4 none) disagreeing with the band; measurement_missing sets measurement null. unit_mismatch logs the unit differently from standards[].unit and makes priority_supported false. location_mismatch shifts defects[].mileage against walk_trace start/end or the mileage quoted in remarks.comment. coverage_gap_pct shows only as walk_trace walked mileage or gaps against patrol booked mileage; a gap covering a defect's mileage, or an outside_walked_range location, means hold_query. Mitigation appears in site_context. repaired_since_signed_off: a repair entry at the defect mileage with a sign-off line in remarks; the defect is no longer outstanding, so urgency and next_step drop. esr_already_imposed: an ESR covering the mileage; urgency stays but monitor may be defensible over raise_repair (contested). inside_active_worksite: a possession covering it. geometry_run_clear_recent: a geometry run within 14 days showing no exceedance, contested against the patroller's measurement. The same alarming measurement appears with and without mitigation at about 50/50. repeat_history appears as site_context.history count and dates; 2 or more nudges monitor towards raise_repair. note_stance softens means the comment downplays a defect; contradicts_entry means the comment quotes a different value or mileage, which needs a query. Decoys: patrol.weather, patrol.line_speed_mph, late-train remarks, defects[].priority itself and photo_flag; none of these settles an answer alone. The record never states the band, urgency, category of the worst defect, a review outcome or a risk label; only the raw fields above appear.

F203.domain: inter-library loan requests between public libraries
F203.role: Lending-side inter-library loan coordinator at a regional public library hub, reviewing each incoming loan request from a partner library
F203.setting: A network of public library authorities shares stock through reciprocal lending agreements. A partner library submits a request on behalf of one of its patrons, and the request lands in the lending hub's queue. The coordinator opens one request record at a time. Each record shows the borrowing library's agreement and loan history, the patron verification, the requested copy's condition and local demand, other copies held across the network, and the courier estimate. For each request the coordinator decides whether to lend, on what terms, how tight the timing is, and how much the lending library would lose if the copy went missing.

borrower_good_standing.instructions: The requesting library is in good standing to receive this loan.

disposition.instructions: What should happen to this inter-library loan request?

criteria.decline: Refuse outright; item cannot be lent or borrower barred.
criteria.redirect: Pass request to another network library holding a lendable copy.
criteria.hold: Pause pending one missing confirmation or record before deciding.
criteria.lend_conditional: Lend, but only with a restriction or extra safeguard attached.
criteria.lend: Lend on standard terms with no added conditions.

loan_restriction.instructions: Which loan restriction should apply if this item is lent?

criteria.standard_loan: Normal loan period with renewals allowed as usual.
criteria.no_renewal: Fixed loan period; borrower may not request renewal.
criteria.library_use_only: Item read only on the borrowing library's premises.
criteria.copy_supplied: Send a scan or photocopy instead of the item.

time_slack.instructions: How much slack remains before the patron's need-by date?
criteria: Missed: estimated arrival falls after need-by date
Tight: arrival 0 to 3 days before need-by
Workable: arrival 4 to 14 days before need-by
Open: over 14 days spare, or no need-by

replacement_difficulty.instructions: How hard would the lent copy be to replace if lost?
criteria: Four or more other lendable copies in network
One to three other lendable copies in network
No other network copy; still in print
No network copy; out of print, secondhand listed
No network copy; out of print, none secondhand

factors.name: agreement_status
factors.description: State of the reciprocal lending agreement between the borrowing library and the hub: active, lapsed, or past expiry with a renewal submitted before the expiry date.

factors.name: borrower_overdue_count
factors.description: Number of items the borrowing library holds from the hub that are past their due date.

factors.name: overdue_mitigated
factors.description: Whether the overdue items carry a return-in-transit scan or an accepted renewal dated before the due date, so they do not count against the borrower. Applies only when the overdue count is above zero.

factors.name: patron_verification
factors.description: Whether the patron's membership is verified, still awaiting verification, or the patron section is missing entirely from the request.

factors.name: item_condition
factors.description: Physical condition grade of the requested copy.

factors.name: conservation_cleared
factors.description: Whether a recent conservation check passed the copy for travel in a protective box. This offsets fragile or worn condition.

factors.name: local_holds_queue
factors.description: Number of the hub's own patrons with holds queued on this copy.

factors.name: network_other_copies
factors.description: Count of other copies across the network whose status is lendable. Copies marked on_loan or reference_only are not counted.

factors.name: print_status
factors.description: Supplier and secondhand market status for the title, which matters only when no other network copy is lendable.

factors.name: request_scope
factors.description: Whether the patron needs the whole item or only a chapter or article that could be supplied as a copy.

factors.name: copyright_declaration_present
factors.description: For chapter or article requests, whether the patron's signed copyright declaration is on file. Its absence blocks supplying a copy until it is received.

factors.name: need_by_slack_days
factors.description: Days between the courier's estimated arrival date and the patron's need-by date. Values are oversampled at the 0/-1, 3/4 and 14/15 boundaries so that some records sit on a scale edge.

factors.name: need_by_missing
factors.description: Whether the request has no need-by date at all, recorded as null.

sections.name: request
sections.description: Request identifiers, submission date, need-by date and requested scope.

sections.name: borrower_library
sections.description: Borrowing library's agreement terms and its current open loans from the hub.

sections.name: patron
sections.description: Requesting patron's membership and verification details; may be null.

sections.name: item
sections.description: Requested copy's bibliographic data, condition, conservation check and local holds.

sections.name: holdings_network
sections.description: Other copies across the network with status, plus supplier print status.

sections.name: logistics
sections.description: Courier route, dispatch date and estimated arrival at the borrowing library.

F203.rendering_notes:
Agreement: agreement_status renders as borrower_library.agreement {status: active|expired, expires_on, renewal_submitted_on}. For renewal_pending, status is 'expired' but renewal_submitted_on is a date earlier than expires_on. For lapsed, status is 'expired' and renewal_submitted_on is null or dated after expires_on, so the out-of-order date is the signal.

Overdue loans: borrower_library.open_loans is a list of {loan_id, due_on, renewed_on, return_scan_on}. The overdue count shows only as loans whose due_on is earlier than request.submitted_on. When overdue_mitigated is true, each overdue loan carries a return_scan_on or a renewed_on dated before due_on; otherwise both are null. Decoy: borrower_library.loans_last_12m is a large, irrelevant count.

Patron: verified shows as patron {member_id, home_branch, verified_on: date}. Pending shows verified_on as null. Missing makes the whole patron section null.

Item condition: item.condition_grade holds the grade. item.conservation_check is {checked_on, outcome, box_supplied}. When conservation_cleared is true, outcome is 'pass' and box_supplied is true, with checked_on within 60 days of submitted_on. Otherwise the check is null, or it is older than 60 days with outcome 'refer'.

Local holds: item.local_holds is an integer. Decoys: item.list_price and item.acquired_on.

Network copies: holdings_network.copies is a list of {library_code, status}, where status is lendable, on_loan or reference_only. Only lendable entries count toward network_other_copies, and the list is padded with on_loan and reference_only decoys. holdings_network.supplier_status renders print_status as in_print, out_of_print, or out_of_print with secondhand_listings as an integer count, where 0 means none.

Scope and copyright: request.scope gives whole_item or extract, with page_range when the scope is an extract. request.copyright_declaration_on is a date or null.

Timing: slack is never stated. The reader computes it from request.need_by against logistics.est_arrival. need_by_missing sets request.need_by to null. Decoy: logistics.route_code.

No field may state standing, a recommended action, a restriction, urgency or scarcity. There is no 'eligible', 'priority', 'risk' or 'recommendation' field anywhere. No free-text fields.

F204.role: Accuracy checking pharmacy technician performing the final accuracy check on each dispensed prescription item before it is bagged
F204.setting: A busy community pharmacy where each dispensed item is checked against its prescription, the patient medication record and the printed label. The checker compares prescribed and dispensed product, strength, form and quantity, reads the label against the prescriber's dosing, looks at queries and interventions already logged, and works out how soon the patient will run short. One record is one dispensed item.

strength_differs.instructions: Dispensed strength differs from the prescribed strength after unit conversion.

criteria.true: Converted pack strength does not equal prescribed strength.
criteria.false: Strengths agree once units and volumes are converted.

next_step.instructions: What should the checker do with this dispensed item next?

criteria.release: Bag as dispensed; nothing outstanding and no annotation needed.
criteria.release_annotated: Release once owing slip, note or counselling flag added.
criteria.hold_query: Keep on hold shelf until one pending confirmation arrives.
criteria.redispense: Return to dispenser to re-pick or relabel before release.

error_category.instructions: What is the most serious unresolved discrepancy category in this item?

criteria.none_found: No unresolved difference between prescription, pack and label.
criteria.quantity_only: Only supplied quantity differs; product and label are correct.
criteria.label_error: Label dose, warnings or patient identifier wrong; product correct.
criteria.product_error: Wrong drug, strength, form or short-dated batch was selected.

open_discrepancies.instructions: How many unresolved discrepancies remain across prescription, pack and label?
criteria: No unresolved discrepancies remain
Exactly one unresolved discrepancy remains
Exactly two unresolved discrepancies remain
Three or more unresolved discrepancies remain

supply_urgency.instructions: How soon will the patient run short of this medicine?
criteria: Routine: home supply covers more than 7 days
Soon: home supply covers 3 to 7 days
Urgent: home supply covers 1 or 2 days
Immediate: home supply exhausted, zero days remaining

factors.name: strength_status
factors.description: Whether dispensed strength matches prescribed strength: same units, equivalent only after converting units or volume (e.g. 250 mg/5 ml vs 50 mg/ml, 0.5 g vs 500 mg), or a genuine mismatch after conversion.

factors.name: product_status
factors.description: How the dispensed product relates to the prescribed one: exact, a generic or brand that is an accepted equivalent (decoy name difference), a different form (e.g. modified-release vs standard), or a different drug.

factors.name: quantity_status
factors.description: Supplied quantity against prescribed quantity: exact, short with a documented owing balance, short with no owing record, or oversupplied.

factors.name: label_status
factors.description: Label against prescription and product data: correct, dose or frequency differs from prescriber, a required warning code missing, or label patient identifier differs from the patient record.

factors.name: prescriber_query
factors.description: State of a query to the prescriber about the item's main discrepancy: none raised, raised and still pending, or confirmed with the prescriber approving the dispensed version.

factors.name: pharmacist_intervention
factors.description: Whether a pharmacist intervention entry accepts the discrepancy on the exact field affected; when false, any intervention present refers to an unrelated field (decoy).

factors.name: clinical_check_signed
factors.description: Whether the pharmacist clinical check has been signed off; unsigned with no other problem makes the item a hold.

factors.name: home_supply_days
factors.description: Days of medicine the patient still has at home on the check date, derived from the previous supply date and the days it covered.

factors.name: emergency_supply
factors.description: Whether an emergency supply has been logged for this medicine since the previous supply, adding its days to home supply and softening an apparently exhausted supply.

factors.name: short_expiry
factors.description: Whether the batch expiry falls before the check date plus the intended days of supply; counts as a product selection discrepancy.

factors.name: prior_error_count
factors.description: Number of earlier near-miss entries for this patient; alarming but never changes any answer on its own.

factors.name: high_risk_drug
factors.description: Whether the drug is on the branch high-risk list (e.g. anticoagulants, weekly methotrexate); shown as a flag that raises alarm but does not by itself decide any answer.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Whether the record is built to sit on a scale boundary: home supply landing exactly between 2 and 3 or 7 and 8 days depending on whether the check day counts, emergency supply dated the check day, or a form difference (film-coated vs plain) whose equivalence is arguable.

sections.name: rx
sections.description: Prescription as written: drug, strength object, form, dose, frequency, quantity, intended days, issue date.

sections.name: patient
sections.description: Patient medication record: identifier, age, previous supplies, emergency supplies, near-miss history count.

sections.name: dispensed
sections.description: Product picked: product name, strength object, form, pack size, packs, owing balance, batch, expiry, required warning codes, high-risk flag.

sections.name: label
sections.description: Printed label fields: patient identifier, dose quantity, frequency per day, warning codes, quantity printed.

sections.name: check_log
sections.description: Check date and time, clinical check sign-off, prescriber queries and pharmacist interventions with the field each covers.

F204.rendering_notes: strength_status: rx.strength {val, unit, per_ml} vs dispensed.strength {val, unit, per_ml}; equivalent cases use different units or per-volume bases so only conversion shows equality; never add a match flag. product_status: rx.drug and rx.form vs dispensed.product_name and dispensed.form; generic_brand_equivalent shows a brand name plus dispensed.generic_name equal to rx.drug; form_differs changes the form code (e.g. MR tab vs tab). quantity_status: rx.qty vs dispensed.packs * dispensed.pack_size; owing_documented adds dispensed.owing {qty, slip_no} making the totals agree; short_undocumented has owing null; label.qty_printed mirrors the supplied quantity. label_status: label.dose_qty and label.freq_per_day vs rx.dose and rx.freq_per_day; label.warning_codes vs dispensed.req_warnings; label.pt_id vs patient.pt_id (differs by one character when mismatched). prescriber_query: check_log.queries list of {raised_at, field, status pending|confirmed}; confirmed resolves the discrepancy on that field and leads to release_annotated; pending on the item's discrepancy leads to hold_query. pharmacist_intervention: check_log.interventions list of {code, field, accepted, by}; only an entry on the matching field resolves it; when the factor is false, any entry present names an unrelated field. clinical_check_signed: check_log.clin_check {by, at} or null. home_supply_days: derive from patient.supplies last entry {date, days_covered} against check_log.checked_at; emergency_supply adds an entry to patient.emergency_supplies {date, days} that must be added; never show a days-remaining field. short_expiry: dispensed.expiry vs checked_at plus rx.days_intended. prior_error_count: patient.near_miss_count; high_risk_drug: dispensed.high_risk true; both are decoys. Disposition logic: any unresolved discrepancy not covered by a pending query gives redispense; otherwise a pending query or unsigned clinical check gives hold_query; otherwise any owing slip, confirmed query or accepted intervention gives release_annotated; else release. error_category takes the most serious unresolved type (product over label over quantity); open_discrepancies counts each unresolved field separately. No field may state an error, risk, urgency, category or recommended action.

F205.role: Ground-handling turnaround quality auditor, reviewing each closed turnaround log the morning after the flight departs
F205.setting: A regional airport ground handler closes a digital turnaround log for every departure. It holds the flight schedule, timestamped milestones, the final loadsheet summary, hold loading entries, service records (fuel, catering, cleaning, pushback) and short remarks typed by ramp staff. The auditor reviews one log at a time. The task is to reconcile the sections, spot missing or out-of-order steps, check whether the recorded delay attribution holds up, and decide whether the log can be closed, needs a confirmation, or must go to investigation. Logs are not pre-flagged, and discrepancies are never labelled as such.

load_reconciled.instructions: Loadsheet bag count and weights match the hold loading records.

criteria.true: Bag counts and hold weights agree within tolerance.
criteria.false: A count or weight differs, or hold log absent.

delay_code_supported.instructions: Recorded delay code is supported by the logged activity timestamps.

log_disposition.instructions: What should happen to this turnaround log next?

criteria.close_clean: No discrepancies found; log accepted exactly as recorded.
criteria.close_with_note: Minor discrepancy fully explained in remarks; annotate, then close.
criteria.hold_confirm: One missing signature or record must be confirmed before closing.
criteria.investigate: Unexplained discrepancy affecting load, safety records or delay attribution.

offblock_delay.instructions: How late was actual off-blocks against scheduled departure time?
criteria: On time: off-blocks early or up to 3 minutes late
Minor: off-blocks 4 to 15 minutes late
Significant: off-blocks 16 to 60 minutes late
Severe: off-blocks more than 60 minutes late

failed_checks.instructions: How many of the standard checks on this record failed?
criteria: No standard checks failed
Exactly one standard check failed
Two or three standard checks failed
Four or more standard checks failed

factors.name: bag_mismatch_size
factors.description: Size of the difference between the loadsheet bag count or weight and the summed hold log entries

factors.name: mismatch_location
factors.description: Which pair of corresponding values carries the discrepancy, when one exists

factors.name: missing_record
factors.description: A required section or service record that is null or absent

factors.name: milestone_out_of_order
factors.description: One milestone timestamp precedes a step it depends on, e.g. doors closed before last bag loaded

factors.name: delay_minutes
factors.description: Actual off-blocks minus scheduled departure in minutes; negative means early

factors.name: delay_code_fit
factors.description: Whether the logged delay code matches which milestone actually ran late

factors.name: explanatory_remark
factors.description: Mitigation: a remark explains the discrepancy, e.g. bags offloaded for a no-show passenger

factors.name: pending_signoff
factors.description: Captain loadsheet acceptance or dispatcher sign-off not yet recorded

factors.name: dg_on_board
factors.description: Dangerous goods carried, making a NOTOC and its signature mandatory

factors.name: decoy_noise
factors.description: A harmless apparent difference that reconciles on inspection

factors.name: boundary_value
factors.description: Delay or mismatch placed exactly on a scale or tolerance threshold

factors.name: turn_type
factors.description: Kind of turnaround, which changes the expected milestones and services

sections.name: flight
sections.description: Flight number, aircraft reg and type, stand, STA, STD, any revised STD, turn type

sections.name: times
sections.description: List of milestones with ISO timestamps: on_blocks, doors_open, fuel_start, boarding_start, last_bag, doors_closed, off_blocks; delay_code and delay_min

sections.name: load
sections.description: Final loadsheet summary: pax_total, bags_count, bags_kg, cargo_kg, fuel_kg, captain_accepted, notoc

sections.name: hold_log
sections.description: List of hold or ULD entries with position, bag_count, weight, weight_unit, transfer flag

sections.name: services
sections.description: Fuel uplift record, catering, cleaning and pushback records, each possibly null

sections.name: remarks
sections.description: One to three short free-text messages from ramp staff with author role and time

F205.rendering_notes: bag_mismatch_size and mismatch_location show only as differences between load figures and hold_log entries summed by the reader, never as a 'mismatch' field. pax_count_vs_boarding_close compares load.pax_total with a boarding count in a remark. fuel_uplift_vs_loadsheet_fuel compares services.fuel.uplift_kg with load.fuel_kg. missing_record renders the field as null or omits the list entry. A missing notoc matters only when dg_on_board shows through a hold_log entry flagged dg:true or a remark mentioning lithium or UN numbers. milestone_out_of_order is visible only by comparing timestamps. delay_minutes is rendered as times.off_blocks against flight.std. If revised_std is present, it is a decoy: the scale still uses the original std. The delay_min field may be rounded or slightly wrong; the timestamps are authoritative. delay_code_fit: the code names a handler activity, e.g. 'baggage' or 'fuelling', and the reader checks whether that milestone ran late. no_code_logged means the delay_code_supported claim is false. explanatory_remark appears in the remarks section, with the same alarming discrepancy rendered with and without it. A remark that only speculates, e.g. 'possibly offloaded', does not count as an explanation. pending_signoff renders as captain_accepted:null or a dispatcher signoff:null. decoy_noise is a weight in lb in one hold entry, totals within 1%, transfer bags listed separately but included in the loadsheet total, or a revised STD. boundary_value puts the delay at exactly 3, 15/16 or 60 minutes, or a bag difference of exactly 2. No record may contain fields such as status, risk, severity, disposition or 'reconciled'. The answers must be derived from the data.

F206.domain: concrete pour records on construction sites
F206.role: Site quality engineer for the main contractor, reviewing each completed concrete pour record before the element is signed off for the next construction stage
F206.setting: A multi-storey frame and groundworks site where every pour of a slab, column, wall or footing produces a structured record. It combines the pour summary, the ready-mix supplier's delivery tickets, on-site slump and cube testing, weather and curing conditions, and the approvals logged against the pour. The engineer cross-checks these sections and decides whether the element can be released, held, investigated or rejected. They also gauge how far the volumes reconcile and how far strength verification has progressed.

mix_conforms.instructions: Every placed load was the specified mix or an approved substitute.

overrun_unmitigated.instructions: A load exceeded the discharge time limit with no recorded mitigation.

criteria.true: A load discharged past the limit, with no retarder or extension.
criteria.false: All loads within limit, or every overrun covered by mitigation.

disposition.instructions: What disposition should this pour record receive at review?

criteria.release: All checks consistent; no deviation or outstanding item remains.
criteria.conditional_release: Minor deviation resolved by added curing, records or monitoring.
criteria.hold: Awaiting one confirmation, such as results or late sign-off.
criteria.investigate: Unresolved deviation needing in-situ testing such as cores or rebound.
criteria.reject: Confirmed nonconformity requiring breakout or replacement of the element.

volume_gap.instructions: How far does net ticketed volume differ from recorded placed volume?
criteria: Within 2% of the recorded placed volume
More than 2%, up to 5% difference
More than 5%, up to 10% difference
More than 10% difference from placed volume

strength_progress.instructions: How far has strength verification progressed for this pour?
criteria: None: no cube sets taken at the pour
Sampled: cubes taken, no strength results logged yet
Early: 7-day results logged, no 28-day results yet
Partial: 28-day results logged for some sets only
Complete: 28-day results logged for every cube set

factors.name: ticket_count
factors.description: Number of delivery tickets (truck loads) for the pour; more tickets give more places for a mismatch to hide.

factors.name: mix_mismatch
factors.description: How ticket mix codes compare with the specified mix in the pour section: none, a trivial formatting difference for the same mix, one load of a different class, or several loads of a different class.

factors.name: substitution_approved
factors.description: Whether approvals hold a mix substitution matching the off-spec code for this element; when false, a decoy substitution for a different element may still appear.

factors.name: volume_discrepancy_pct
factors.description: Percentage gap between net ticketed volume (sum of ticket volumes minus returned concrete) and placed volume in the pour section, rounded to one decimal; values sometimes land exactly on 2.0, 5.0 or 10.0.

factors.name: returned_concrete_present
factors.description: Whether one or more tickets record returned concrete that must be subtracted before comparison; this explains apparent gaps between the gross ticket sum and placed volume.

factors.name: discharge_overrun
factors.description: Worst gap between ticket batch time and discharge end time compared with the pour's maximum discharge minutes: none, marginal (within 5 minutes over), one load clearly over, or several loads over.

factors.name: overrun_mitigated
factors.description: Whether overrunning loads carry a retarder admixture on the ticket or a matching discharge extension in approvals; when false, a decoy plasticiser or an extension dated for another pour may appear.

factors.name: cube_progress
factors.description: State of cube testing: no sets taken, sets taken with no results, 7-day results only, 28-day results for some sets, or 28-day results for all sets.

factors.name: cube_result_status
factors.description: Where results exist, how they compare with the specified characteristic strength: all clear, one result marginally low, or the set mean below specification.

factors.name: site_water
factors.description: Water added on site per ticket against the supplier allowance: none, within allowance, beyond allowance with a logged approval, or beyond allowance without approval.

factors.name: weather_exposure
factors.description: Ambient conditions and protection: normal, cold below 5 °C with frost protection logged, cold without protection, or hot above 30 °C with curing compound applied.

factors.name: prepour_signoff
factors.description: Pre-pour inspection timestamp compared with the first discharge time: signed before the pour, signed after the pour started, or missing.

factors.name: slump_outliers
factors.description: Number of loads whose site slump falls outside the specified slump range.

factors.name: slump_retest_passed
factors.description: Whether out-of-range loads have a logged retest within range before placement; mitigates slump outliers.

sections.name: pour
sections.description: Pour id, element, grid ref, pour date, spec mix, planned and placed m3, max discharge minutes, slump range, cube sets required.

sections.name: delivery_tickets
sections.description: List of loads: ticket_no, mix_code, vol_m3, returned_m3, batch_time, discharge_end, admixtures list, water_added_l, water_allow_l.

sections.name: site_tests
sections.description: Slump checks per ticket with retest entries, concrete temperature, and cube sets with 7d and 28d results arrays (null if pending).

sections.name: conditions
sections.description: Ambient min and max °C, frost_protection boolean, curing_method, curing_start time.

sections.name: approvals
sections.description: Pre-pour check signed_at, substitutions list, discharge_extensions list, water_additions list, each with element ref and date.

F206.rendering_notes: pour.spec_mix holds the specified class (e.g. C32/40); mix_mismatch shows only in delivery_tickets[].mix_code. trivial_format renders the same class differently (e.g. 'C32/40 S3' or a supplier code that maps to it); wrong loads carry another class. substitution_approved adds an approvals.substitutions entry whose from/to codes and element ref match; when false, a decoy entry may name another element or another code. volume_discrepancy_pct is realised by setting pour.placed_vol_m3 against sum(vol_m3) minus sum(returned_m3); returned_concrete_present puts non-zero returned_m3 on tickets, so the gross sum looks wrong while the net sum matches, or the reverse. No computed volume or gap field exists. discharge_overrun is realised only through batch_time and discharge_end against pour.max_discharge_min; no elapsed-minutes field is shown. overrun_mitigated adds a retarder in that ticket's admixtures or an approvals.discharge_extensions entry with matching ticket_no and date; decoys are plasticiser admixtures and extensions for another date or pour. cube_progress drives which site_tests.cube_sets exist and which result arrays are null; the number of sets taken may be below pour.cube_sets_required. cube_result_status sets result values against the class implied by spec_mix; no pass or fail flag is shown. site_water appears as water_added_l versus water_allow_l per ticket, with any approval in approvals.water_additions. weather_exposure appears in conditions only. prepour_signoff sets approvals.prepour_signed_at relative to the earliest discharge time, or null. slump_outliers set site_tests slump values outside pour.slump_range, and slump_retest_passed adds a later in-range retest for the same ticket. Records never carry fields such as status, compliant, risk, disposition, overrun or discrepancy; every answer must be derived by comparing sections. Identifiers, timestamps and units stay consistent apart from the planted mismatches; all volumes are in m3, and unknowns are null.

F207.role: Incoming loans conservator at the borrowing museum, reviewing each arrival condition report against the lender's outgoing report and transit record before an object goes on display
F207.setting: A borrowing museum receives loaned objects for temporary exhibitions. Each loan produces one record joining the lender's outgoing condition report, the crate logger and courier record, the borrower's arrival examination, any lender-approved variations and a 12-month issue log for the object. The conservator reviews one record at a time and decides whether new damage is real, whether transit breached the agreed environment, what to do with the object and how serious any change is.

new_damage.instructions: The arrival report records damage not documented by the lender beforehand.

criteria.true: At least one arrival defect absent from outgoing text and photos
criteria.false: Every arrival defect is documented in outgoing text or photos

transit_breach.instructions: Crate logger data shows the agreed environmental limits were breached.

criteria.true: Readings outside limits longer than the agreed allowance
criteria.false: No excursion, excursion within allowance, or data unusable

disposition.instructions: What should happen to the object after this arrival review?

criteria.install: Proceed to installation under the standard loan agreement terms
criteria.install_conditions: Install only with added monitoring or handling restrictions agreed
criteria.hold_crated: Keep off display until one missing check or confirmation arrives
criteria.return_lender: Withdraw from exhibition and arrange return or lender-directed treatment

recurrence_count.instructions: How often has this same issue been logged in 12 months?
criteria: First occurrence; not logged in prior 12 months
Logged once before within the past 12 months
Logged two to four times in 12 months
Logged five or more times in 12 months

change_severity.instructions: How serious is the condition change since the outgoing report?
criteria: No new or worsened defects recorded on arrival
New defects all cosmetic: dust, abrasion or bloom
Structural or loss defect, total area under 2 cm²
Structural or loss defect, total area 2 cm² or more

factors.name: object_medium
factors.description: Material class of the loaned object; changes which defect types and RH limits are typical, so the same questions apply across very different objects

factors.name: new_defect_count
factors.description: Number of arrival defects with no matching outgoing defect id

factors.name: worst_new_defect_class
factors.description: Most serious class among unmatched arrival defects

factors.name: loss_area_cm2
factors.description: Summed area of structural or loss defects on arrival; often sampled close to the 2 cm² boundary

factors.name: defect_in_lender_photos
factors.description: Unmatched arrival defect is visible in the lender's outgoing photo set though the written report omitted it; benign explanation for apparent new damage

factors.name: logger_outcome
factors.description: What the crate logger recorded relative to agreed limits

factors.name: excursion_explained
factors.description: Logger mounted outside the inner case, or courier event log shows a brief customs door opening matching the excursion window; lowers concern about a breach reading

factors.name: outgoing_report_status
factors.description: Whether the lender's outgoing report exists and was signed

factors.name: courier_sequence
factors.description: Order of crate opening and courier sign-off; an out-of-order or absent courier weakens the chain of custody

factors.name: acclimatisation_hours
factors.description: Hours the crate rested before opening, compared with the agreement's required hours (usually 24); short rest means examination was premature

factors.name: lender_variation_approved
factors.description: Lender has approved a display variation (reduced lux, case mounting, extra monitoring) covering the observed condition; makes conditional installation available

factors.name: signal_balance
factors.description: Whether the record's signals point clearly one way or sit in balance (e.g. breach plus explanation, area at 1.9 to 2.1 cm², unsigned report with matching photos)

factors.name: prior_issue_entries
factors.description: Number of entries in the 12-month issue log with the same issue code as the current worst change; feeds the shared recurrence scale

sections.name: loan
sections.description: Loan reference, object id, medium, lender code and agreed limits: rh_min, rh_max, temp_min_c, temp_max_c, max_excursion_min, acclim_hours_req

sections.name: outgoing_report
sections.description: Lender's pre-dispatch report: examined_at, signed_by_lender, defects list (id, class, location, area_cm2) and photo_set with defect_ids_visible; null if not received

sections.name: transit
sections.description: Courier and crate record: courier_present, crate_opened_at, courier_signoff_at, logger position, rh_min_obs, rh_max_obs, minutes_outside, gap_minutes, events list of codes

sections.name: arrival_report
sections.description: Borrower's examination: examined_at, rest_hours, defects list (id, class, location, area_cm2, matched_outgoing_id or null, photo_ref)

sections.name: approvals
sections.description: Lender-approved variations list: code, scope_location, approved_at; empty list if none

sections.name: issue_log
sections.description: 12-month log of condition issues for this object: date, issue_code, loan_ref

F207.rendering_notes: object_medium appears as loan.medium; RH and temperature limits in loan vary plausibly by medium. new_defect_count is never stated: it is the count of arrival_report.defects with matched_outgoing_id null. worst_new_defect_class and loss_area_cm2 appear as defect class codes (dust, abrasion, bloom = cosmetic; flake_loss, lifting, crack, tear, chip = structural/loss) and area_cm2 values the reader must sum. defect_in_lender_photos shows as an unmatched arrival defect at a location whose id or location appears in outgoing_report.photo_set.defect_ids_visible or a photo location tag, while the written defects list omits it. logger_outcome is shown only via rh_min_obs/rh_max_obs, minutes_outside and gap_minutes, to be compared with loan limits and max_excursion_min; data_gap means gap_minutes large and minutes_outside null. excursion_explained appears as transit.logger.position = 'crate_exterior' or an events entry such as 'CUSTOMS_OPEN' timed within the excursion window. outgoing_report_status: present_signed has signed_by_lender true; unsigned has false; missing sets outgoing_report to null, so all arrival defects have null matches but cannot prove new damage. courier_sequence shows via crate_opened_at earlier than courier_signoff_at's paired arrival or courier_present false with courier_signoff_at null. acclimatisation_hours appears as arrival_report.rest_hours, compared with loan.acclim_hours_req. lender_variation_approved appears as an approvals entry whose scope_location matches a defect location; decoy approvals with non-matching locations or approved_at after examined_at also occur. prior_issue_entries appear as issue_log rows with matching issue_code, mixed with decoy rows of other codes or older than 12 months. Decoys: cosmetic defects with large area_cm2 (dust spread) that do not raise severity, excursions on temperature only within limits, matched defects with slightly different area. No record contains fields like severity, verdict, breach_flag, new_damage or recommended_action; all answers must be derived by comparing sections.

F208.role: Doctoral examinations officer in a university graduate school, checking each final thesis deposit before it is released to examiners
F208.setting: A research-degrees office at an invented university. Doctoral candidates deposit a final thesis through an online portal. For each deposit, the officer reconciles the deposit against registration records, automated document checks, approvals and free-text notes. The officer then decides whether the thesis goes to examiners, is held, is returned or is referred onwards, and how urgent the processing is.

ethics_covered.instructions: Ethics approval covered every reported human-participant data collection date.

criteria.true: Approval, including amendments, spans all collection dates, or no participants
criteria.false: Collection falls outside approval, or required approval not found

overlap_explained.instructions: Similarity overlap is explained by the candidate's own listed prior publications.

criteria.true: Matched sources are the candidate's declared publications
criteria.false: Matched sources unlisted or third-party, or explanation merely asserted

next_step.instructions: What should the officer do with this deposit next?

criteria.accept_for_exam: No failed requirements; forward thesis to nominated examiners now
criteria.forward_conditional: Only cosmetic format defects; forward, with corrections due before viva
criteria.hold_query: One confirmation outstanding, such as pending extension or sign-off
criteria.return_student: Substantive requirement failed; candidate must revise and redeposit
criteria.refer_panel: Unexplained similarity or ethics breach; refer to integrity panel

failed_reqs.instructions: How many formal submission requirements does the deposit currently fail?
criteria: None: every listed formal requirement passes after reconciliation
Single: exactly one formal requirement fails
Several: two or three formal requirements fail
Many: four or more formal requirements fail

urgency.instructions: How urgent is processing relative to the effective registration end date?
criteria: More than 90 days before effective end date
Between 31 and 90 days before effective end date
Between 0 and 30 days before effective end date
Effective end date already passed on deposit date

factors.name: word_count_gap
factors.description: Size of the discrepancy between the word count the candidate declared at deposit and the word count measured by the automated PDF check

factors.name: length_status
factors.description: Where the measured word count sits against the programme limit, and whether any excess has been authorised

factors.name: ethics_coverage
factors.description: How the reported data collection dates relate to the dates of the ethics approval on file

factors.name: ethics_amendment
factors.description: Whether a recorded ethics amendment extends the approval far enough to cover dates that would otherwise fall outside it

factors.name: similarity_pct
factors.description: Overall overlap percentage reported by the text-matching tool; the threshold for review is 25%

factors.name: overlap_source
factors.description: Where the largest matched sources come from, compared with the candidate's declared publications

factors.name: signoff_alignment
factors.description: Whether the supervisor's sign-off refers to the version actually deposited

factors.name: registration_window
factors.description: Days between the deposit date and the base enrolment end date, before any extension is applied

factors.name: extension_status
factors.description: Status of any request to extend the registration end date

factors.name: format_defects
factors.description: Number of failed cosmetic format checks, drawn from margins, abstract length, missing declaration page and front-matter order

factors.name: title_mismatch
factors.description: Difference between the deposited title and the approved title held in registration

factors.name: fees_state
factors.description: Tuition fee position at the time of deposit

factors.name: note_tone
factors.description: Content of the free-text notes, which may sound alarming but be benign, or sound reassuring but be irrelevant

factors.name: prior_deposits
factors.description: Count of earlier deposits of this thesis that were withdrawn or returned

sections.name: candidate
sections.description: Identifier, programme, degree, approved thesis title and declared publications list

sections.name: registration
sections.description: Enrolment end date, extension request with status and new date, fee position

sections.name: deposit
sections.description: Deposit date, version id, deposited title, declared word count, student_statement free text

sections.name: checks
sections.description: Automated results: measured word count, word limit, similarity percentage with top sources, format check list

sections.name: approvals
sections.description: Supervisor sign-off with version id and date, ethics reference, approval and expiry dates, amendments, collection dates

sections.name: notes
sections.description: Short free text: supervisor_comment and officer_log line, plus prior_deposits history list

F208.rendering_notes: word_count_gap: deposit.words_declared is compared with checks.words_measured; the gap is never flagged. length_status: checks.words_measured is compared with checks.word_limit. Approved or pending excess appears only in registration.excess_request {status, words_allowed}. at_limit_boundary places the measured count within 0.5% of the limit, so judges may split. ethics_coverage: approvals.ethics {ref, approved_on, expires_on, amendments[]} is compared with approvals.collection [{from, to}]. no_participants shows an empty collection list and ref null. no_ref_found shows collection dates with ref null. ethics_amendment adds an amendments entry whose new_expiry covers the otherwise uncovered dates (p 0.5), so the same expiry gap appears both mitigated and unmitigated. similarity_pct goes in checks.similarity.pct. overlap_source goes in checks.similarity.top_sources [{title, pct}], which must be compared with candidate.publications[]. asserted_not_listed means a student_statement claims own prior work but the sources are absent from publications; this makes overlap_explained false. signoff_alignment: approvals.signoff {version_id, date} is compared with deposit.version_id and deposit.deposited_on. A predates-final case may be explained by supervisor_comment ('minor typo fixes after sign-off'). registration_window and extension_status: the effective end date is registration.end_date, or registration.extension.new_end if status is approved. A pending extension leaves urgency contested and makes hold_query natural. format_defects goes in checks.format [{item, pass}]. title_mismatch: candidate.approved_title is compared with deposit.title, and a title change approval appears in registration.title_change. fees_state goes in registration.fees {status, plan_ref}. The formal requirements counted for failed_reqs are: word limit without approved excess; each failed format item; sign-off missing or predating major edits; unapproved substantive title change; ethics gap; fees outstanding without plan. Similarity is an integrity matter, not a formal requirement. For next_step, apply the most serious applicable option, so that only one fits. Decoys: alarming_benign notes (e.g. 'chapter 3 rewritten in a panic last week'); reassuring_irrelevant notes (e.g. 'supervisor very happy with progress'); prior_deposits history; high similarity fully explained by own publications. No field may state a verdict, risk, urgency, failure count or recommended action. Check results appear only as raw values or per-item pass booleans, as a real portal would show them. Unknown values are null, dates are ISO, and numbers are numbers.

F209.domain: fire extinguisher service records in office buildings
F209.role: Fire safety compliance reviewer for a managing agent's office portfolio, checking each extinguisher service record returned by the maintenance contractor before it is filed to the building's fire log
F209.setting: A property management firm runs a portfolio of multi-tenant office buildings. An external contractor services portable fire extinguishers and uploads one structured record per unit per visit. The reviewer opens one record at a time. Each record combines the unit's identity and specification, the visit's check results, the replacement tag fitted, the unit's prior service history, the building register entry and any remedial actions. The reviewer must decide whether the unit was left compliant, what happens to the record next, which service level was actually due, how late the visit was, and how many cross-section values disagree. Records contain no free text, only coded fields, numbers, dates, booleans and nulls.

left_compliant.instructions: The unit was left compliant and in service after this visit.

next_step.instructions: What should the reviewer do with this service record next?

criteria.accept_record: Record consistent and unit compliant; file without further action.
criteria.hold_confirm: Exactly one detail needs contractor confirmation before filing.
criteria.schedule_revisit: Work incomplete or wrong; technician must return to the unit.
criteria.withdraw_unit: Unit unsafe or expired; remove from service and replace now.

service_level_due.instructions: Which service level was due for this unit at the visit?

criteria.interim_check: Basic service not yet due; visual inspection only required.
criteria.basic_service: Annual basic service due; no age-based extended work due.
criteria.extended_service: Five-yearly discharge or extended service due by unit age.
criteria.overhaul: CO2 ten-year overhaul with pressure test due by age.
criteria.replacement: Unit beyond twenty-year life; replacement due instead of service.

visit_lateness.instructions: How far past its applicable due date was the service visit?
criteria: On time: visit on or before the applicable due date
Slightly late: visit 1 to 30 days past due
Late: visit 31 to 90 days past due
Severely late: visit more than 90 days past due

mismatch_count.instructions: How many corresponding values disagree between sections of this record?
criteria: No corresponding values disagree between sections
Exactly one corresponding value disagrees
Two or three corresponding values disagree
Four or more corresponding values disagree

factors.name: unit_type
factors.description: Extinguisher medium; decides which checks apply (gauge pressure for stored-pressure types, weight loss for CO2) and which age-based service schedule applies.

factors.name: unit_age_years
factors.description: Whole years between manufacture_date and the visit date; at 5, 10 and 15 years non-CO2 units need extended service, CO2 at 10 years needs overhaul, and any unit 20 years or older needs replacement. Ages placed one month either side of a threshold are common.

factors.name: service_level_gap
factors.description: Relation between the service_type the technician recorded and the level actually due by age and history: matched, under-performed (lower level done than due) or over-performed (higher level done than needed).

factors.name: days_past_due
factors.description: Days between the unit's due date (last basic service in history plus 12 months, or the deferral expiry if one applies) and the visit date; negative means early. Clustered values sit on 0, 30/31 and 90/91.

factors.name: deferral_approved
factors.description: An approved service deferral is on file in the register that moves the applicable due date later, so a visit that looks late against history may be on time.

factors.name: injected_mismatch_count
factors.description: Number of corresponding values deliberately made to disagree across sections: asset id on tag vs unit, type in register vs unit, capacity vs register, floor or zone vs register, tag service date vs visit date, recorded full weight vs specification. Some are trivial (one day, one floor letter), some large.

factors.name: physical_defect
factors.description: Alarming condition found at the visit, shown through numbers and booleans: pressure outside the gauge green band, seal or tamper tag missing, hose condition failed, corrosion flag, or CO2 weight loss above 10%.

factors.name: defect_rectified_on_visit
factors.description: When a defect exists, a remedial action dated the same day as the visit is marked completed (recharge, new seal, new hose or a replacement unit id), lowering concern; otherwise the action is open or absent.

factors.name: type_location_mismatch
factors.description: The unit's medium is unsuitable for the risk class the register gives its location (for example water in a zone classed electrical, or no wet chemical in a kitchen zone).

factors.name: location_exemption_on_file
factors.description: The register holds an approved, unexpired risk-assessment exemption for the location, which makes an apparent type-location mismatch acceptable; present on mismatched and matched units about equally.

factors.name: record_gap
factors.description: An incomplete part of the record: some check fields null, tag section null or tag date not updated, remedial action raised but uncompleted, or history list empty for a unit older than one year.

factors.name: technician_cert_status
factors.description: Status of the technician's competence certificate relative to the visit date: valid, expired before the visit, or valid but expiring within 30 days after it (a decoy that does not invalidate the visit).

factors.name: out_of_order_dates
factors.description: Dates in the record occur in an impossible order: a remedial action completed before it was raised, a tag service date before the previous history entry, or a visit date before the manufacture date of a replacement unit.

factors.name: borderline_case
factors.description: Places one deciding value exactly on an open boundary: pressure equal to the green band limit, weight loss exactly 10%, age within a month of a service threshold, or lateness exactly on a level edge, leaving judges split.

sections.name: unit
sections.description: Asset identity and specification: asset_id, type, capacity_kg, manufacture_date, full_weight_kg, gauge_green_min_bar, gauge_green_max_bar.

sections.name: visit
sections.description: The service visit: visit_date, tech_cert_no, tech_cert_expiry, service_type, and a checks object with pressure_bar, weight_kg, seal_ok, tamper_tag_ok, hose_ok, corrosion, discharge_done, hydro_test_done.

sections.name: tag
sections.description: Service label fitted at the visit: tag_asset_id, tag_service_date, tag_next_due, tag_service_type; may be null.

sections.name: history
sections.description: List of prior visits, each with date, service_type and result code (pass, fail, rectified).

sections.name: register
sections.description: Building register entry: reg_asset_id, reg_type, reg_capacity_kg, floor, zone, zone_risk_class, deferral {approved, ref, expires}, exemption {approved, ref, expires}.

sections.name: remedial
sections.description: List of actions, each with action_code, raised, completed (date or null), replacement_asset_id (or null).

F209.rendering_notes: No free-text fields: every value is a code, number, date, boolean or null. unit_type appears as unit.type and, possibly altered, as register.reg_type. unit_age_years is never stated; it must be computed from unit.manufacture_date and visit.visit_date. service_level_gap shows only as visit.service_type plus discharge_done and hydro_test_done booleans, to be compared with the level implied by age and by the last extended or overhaul entry in history. days_past_due is never stated; the due date is derived from the most recent basic or higher entry in history plus 12 months, replaced by register.deferral.expires when deferral.approved is true and the expiry is later; tag_next_due is a decoy that may itself be wrong. injected_mismatch_count is realised by altering the counterpart fields (tag_asset_id vs asset_id, reg_type vs type, reg_capacity_kg vs capacity_kg, tag_service_date vs visit_date, register floor and zone vs replacement unit location codes, full_weight_kg vs reg_capacity_kg-implied weight); mismatches are never flagged and vary in size; formatting differences such as 2 vs 2.0 are not mismatches. physical_defect shows as numbers outside unit gauge bounds, weight_kg below 90% of full_weight_kg for CO2, or false booleans in checks; gauge fields are null for CO2 and weight below 90% is irrelevant for stored-pressure types, which acts as a decoy. defect_rectified_on_visit shows as a remedial entry with raised equal to visit_date and completed set; when false the entry has completed null or is missing. type_location_mismatch shows only by comparing unit.type with register.zone_risk_class; location_exemption_on_file is register.exemption with approved true and expires after visit_date, and it also appears on correctly matched units as a decoy. record_gap appears as nulls in checks, a null tag section, a tag_service_date older than visit_date, an open remedial entry, or an empty history list. technician_cert_status is visible only by comparing visit.tech_cert_expiry with visit_date; expiring_soon is a decoy. out_of_order_dates appears as remedial completed earlier than raised, or tag or history dates in impossible order. borderline_case places the relevant value exactly on a threshold. Answers are never stated: there is no compliant, overdue, risk, status or result field for the current visit, and history result codes describe only past visits.

F210.domain: milk collection tanker tests at dairy farms
F210.role: Milk intake quality controller at a dairy processing site, reviewing one farm collection record at a time
F210.setting: Each record covers a single farm pick-up by a collection tanker: the driver's on-farm readings and checks, the sealed sample taken for the lab, the lab results, the farm's contract limits and approved exceptions, and the calibration state of farm and tanker equipment. The controller decides whether the vat milk was held at a compliant temperature, what happens to the collection at intake, which source best explains the main inconsistency, and how many results breach limits without a recorded explanation.

temp_compliant.instructions: Vat milk was held at compliant temperature before collection.

criteria.true: Vat temperature within limit, or warm only after recent milking.
criteria.false: Over limit without recent milking, or temperature reading missing.

intake_disposition.instructions: What should happen to this farm collection at intake?

criteria.accept_full: All results within limits or covered; pay standard price.
criteria.accept_deduction: Confirmed quality band breach without exception; accept with price penalty.
criteria.hold_retest: One result awaits confirmation before acceptance or penalty is decided.
criteria.reject_load: Confirmed inhibitory positive or gross failure; milk not accepted.

issue_source.instructions: Which single source best explains the main inconsistency in this record?

criteria.none_evident: Sections agree and no result falls outside contract limits.
criteria.recording_error: Mismatch traced to meter, timestamp or identifier entry, not milk.
criteria.collection_handling: Seal, sample temperature or compartment problem arising after pick-up.
criteria.farm_practice: Vat cooling, hygiene, treatment or dilution on farm explains it.

discrepancy_size.instructions: How far does the recorded value differ from the expected value?
criteria: Matches expected value, or differs by under 2%
Differs from expected value by 2% to under 10%
Differs from expected value by 10% to under 25%
Differs from expected value by 25% or more

unexplained_breaches.instructions: How many test parameters exceed contract limits without a recorded explanation?
criteria: No unexplained parameter above its contract limit
One unexplained parameter above its contract limit
Two unexplained parameters above their contract limits
Three or more unexplained parameters above limits

factors.name: vat_temp_level
factors.description: Vat temperature read by the driver at pick-up relative to the 6.0 °C limit: compliant, on or just above the limit (6.0-7.0), or clearly high (above 7.0).

factors.name: recent_milking
factors.description: Last milking ended within 2 hours of collection, which permits a vat up to 10 °C; mitigates a warm vat reading.

factors.name: mismatch_site
factors.description: Where corresponding values across sections disagree: farm vat volume vs tanker meter, sample id on seal vs lab, sample time vs collection time, compartment on sample vs collection, or none.

factors.name: mismatch_magnitude
factors.description: Size of the cross-section disagreement: trivial (rounding, under 0.5% volume or minutes), moderate (1-3% volume or a transposed digit), large (over 5% volume or a different sample).

factors.name: meter_calibration_overdue
factors.description: Tanker meter or farm vat dipstick calibration is past due, offering a benign equipment explanation for a volume mismatch.

factors.name: lab_limit_breaches
factors.description: Raw count of lab parameters (bactoscan, cell count, freezing point, thermoduric count) over contract limits before considering exceptions.

factors.name: exception_covers_breach
factors.description: An in-date approved exception (e.g. cell count derogation under a mastitis plan, seasonal freezing point allowance) covers one of the breached parameters.

factors.name: inhibitory_status
factors.description: Inhibitory substance screen result on the farm sample.

factors.name: treatment_withdrawal_active
factors.description: Farm treatment register lists a cow whose withdrawal period ends after the collection date, with or without a recorded segregation of her milk.

factors.name: retest_state
factors.description: State of any confirmatory retest on a flagged result: none requested, pending, completed confirming, completed clearing.

factors.name: sample_integrity
factors.description: Condition of the lab sample on arrival: sealed and cold, arrival temperature above 8 °C, or seal broken or missing.

factors.name: history_breaches_90d
factors.description: Number of collections in the last 90 days with a limit breach; context only, decoy when current results are clean.

factors.name: value_on_boundary
factors.description: A deciding value (vat temperature, cell count or freezing point) sits exactly on its contract limit, where the contract wording leaves pass or fail open.

factors.name: driver_sensory_flag
factors.description: Driver marked smell or appearance as not normal at pick-up; often uncorroborated by lab results, sometimes matching a high bactoscan.

sections.name: collection
sections.description: Pick-up details: farm_id, route_id, tanker_id, compartment, collected_at, vat_l, meter_l, vat_temp_c, last_milking_end, driver_checks.

sections.name: sample
sections.description: Lab sample record: sample_id, farm_id, compartment, taken_at, seal_no, seal_intact, arrival_temp_c, received_at.

sections.name: lab_results
sections.description: Lab analysis: sample_id, tested_at, bactoscan_kcfu_ml, scc_k_ml, freezing_point_mc, thermoduric_cfu_ml, fat_pct, protein_pct, inhibitory, retest.

sections.name: farm_terms
sections.description: Contract limits, approved_exceptions list with valid_from/valid_to, treatment_register entries, breaches_90d count.

sections.name: equipment
sections.description: Calibration dates and due dates for vat thermometer, vat dipstick and tanker meter; last cooling service.

F210.rendering_notes: vat_temp_level appears only as collection.vat_temp_c (null when not_recorded); recent_milking is inferred from collection.last_milking_end vs collected_at (within 2 h or not), never flagged. mismatch_site and mismatch_magnitude show as disagreement between collection.vat_l and collection.meter_l, sample.sample_id vs lab_results.sample_id, sample.taken_at vs collection.collected_at, or sample.compartment vs collection.compartment; size follows magnitude; records with mismatch_site none have all pairs agreeing exactly or within rounding. meter_calibration_overdue shows as equipment.*.due date earlier than collected_at. lab_limit_breaches show as lab values above farm_terms.limits; exception_covers_breach adds an approved_exceptions entry naming one breached parameter with dates spanning the collection (sometimes a decoy entry that has expired or names a different parameter). inhibitory_status is lab_results.inhibitory as 'neg', 'presumptive_pos', 'confirmed_pos' or null; retest_state is lab_results.retest {requested, result} with null result when pending. treatment_withdrawal_active appears as a treatment_register entry with withdrawal_end after collected_at, with a segregated boolean true or false. sample_integrity appears via sample.seal_intact and sample.arrival_temp_c. history_breaches_90d is farm_terms.breaches_90d. value_on_boundary sets one value exactly equal to its limit. driver_sensory_flag is collection.driver_checks.smell_ok or appearance_ok false. Decoys: fat_pct and protein_pct (payment only, no limits), route_id, tanker_id, driver_checks.agitation_min, last cooling service date, breaches_90d when current results are clean, expired exceptions. No free-text fields. The record never states compliance, disposition, cause, breach counts or price outcome; there is no status, risk or verdict field.

F211.role: Hub fleet readiness officer at a regional ambulance station, reviewing each vehicle's start-of-shift readiness check before the vehicle is placed on the dispatch rota
F211.setting: Every emergency ambulance and rapid response car gets a daily readiness check at shift start. The crew completes a sectioned checklist on a tablet: vehicle systems, clinical equipment, and drugs and consumables. They log defects with a short description, and a supervisor countersigns. The readiness officer opens one check record at a time. They compare it with the vehicle's service data, stock expiries, workshop job cards, dispatch mobilisation time and recent check history. They then decide whether the vehicle goes on the rota, with what restriction, and how complete and serious the open issues are. Alarming crew notes and defects are often offset by deferrals, substitutes carried or recent workshop work. Missing signatures or out-of-order timestamps are themselves evidence.

defects_controlled.instructions: All safety-critical defects recorded are resolved or validly deferred.

readiness_status.instructions: What readiness status should this vehicle be given today?

criteria.release: Fully available; no open defects or restrictions affect deployment.
criteria.release_with_note: Available for all work; minor open items logged for follow-up.
criteria.restricted: Available only for non-emergency work until a known limitation clears.
criteria.hold: Kept off the rota until one missing confirmation is recorded.
