criteria.off_road: Withdrawn from service pending repair, replacement or full re-check.

limiting_area.instructions: Which area most limits this vehicle's readiness today?

criteria.no_limitation: Nothing open or missing reduces the vehicle's availability.
criteria.vehicle_systems: Chassis, engine, lights, tyres or service interval drive the restriction.
criteria.clinical_equipment: Medical devices such as defibrillator, suction or oxygen drive it.
criteria.stock_and_drugs: Drug expiries or missing consumables are the deciding restriction.

check_completeness.instructions: How complete is today's readiness check record?
criteria: Minimal: fewer than half of required sections signed
Partial: at least half signed, some still unsigned
Unverified: all sections signed, no supervisor countersignature
Complete: all sections signed and countersigned by supervisor

defect_severity.instructions: How serious is the worst open defect on the vehicle?
criteria: No open defects recorded on this check
Only cosmetic or comfort items left open
Open defect limited to non-critical equipment or fittings
Critical item faulty, working substitute carried on board
Critical item faulty with no substitute on board

factors.name: checklist_completion
factors.description: How far the crew got through the required checklist sections and whether a supervisor countersigned. It drives the completeness score directly and pushes the status towards hold when only the countersignature is missing.

factors.name: worst_defect_tier
factors.description: Criticality of the worst defect still open, inferred from the item named (for example defibrillator or brakes versus a locker latch) and whether a substitute is carried.

factors.name: defect_area
factors.description: Which checklist area the worst open defect belongs to. Decides the limiting area unless a stock expiry or an overdue service outweighs it.

factors.name: deferral_authorised
factors.description: Mitigation. The worst critical or non-critical defect carries a deferral with a named authoriser and a valid_until date. When genuine, it lets the vehicle run with restriction or a note rather than go off road.

factors.name: deferral_invalid
factors.description: When a deferral exists, it is undermined in one of two ways: either valid_until falls before the shift date, or authorised_at is later than the vehicle's first mobilisation. This makes the deferral evidence of disorder rather than control.

factors.name: workshop_return_recent
factors.description: Mitigation. A workshop job card dated within the last 48 hours reports the logged defect item as repaired. The crew may have re-logged it from habit, but no post-repair test entry exists, so judges may split between release and hold.

factors.name: earliest_drug_expiry_days
factors.description: Days from shift date to the earliest expiry among carried drugs and sterile consumables. Negative means already expired. Values of 0 to 2 sit on the boundary where a restock in progress may or may not suffice.

factors.name: restock_in_progress
factors.description: Mitigation. A pharmacy restock request is raised with an ETA inside the shift for the expiring or short items. It offsets short-dated stock about half the time the issue appears.

factors.name: service_margin_km
factors.description: Kilometres remaining before the scheduled service: service_due_km minus odometer_km. Negative means overdue. Values near zero are boundary cases between a note and a restriction.

factors.name: crew_note_tone
factors.description: Character of the free-text crew note relative to the actual record. It may sound alarming while describing something benign, be matter-of-fact, understate a real problem, or be absent. It is a decoy whose wording must be checked against the structured fields.

factors.name: signed_after_mobilisation
factors.description: The check's signed_at timestamp is later than the vehicle's first dispatch mobilisation of the shift, showing the vehicle went out before its check was finished.

factors.name: repeat_defect_count
factors.description: Number of prior checks in the last 14 days logging the same defect item. Higher counts suggest an unresolved recurring fault even when today's entry looks minor.

sections.name: vehicle
sections.description: Callsign, registration, vehicle type, odometer_km, service_due_km, base station.

sections.name: check
sections.description: Check id, shift_date, started_at, signed_at, signer grade, sections_required, sections_signed list, countersigned_by (null if absent), crew_note free text.

sections.name: defects
sections.description: List of logged defects: item, area, desc free text, status, substitute_on_board, deferral object or null.

sections.name: stock
sections.description: Drug and consumable lines with qty, par_level, expiry date; restock_request object or null.

sections.name: activity
sections.description: First mobilisation time this shift, recent workshop job cards with job_note, and prior checks with defect items.

F211.rendering_notes: checklist_completion appears as check.sections_signed compared with check.sections_required, and check.countersigned_by set to a name or null. Under-half cases may also leave signed_at null. worst_defect_tier is never stated. It is inferred from defects[].item: critical items include defibrillator, suction unit, main oxygen, brakes, steering and blue lights; non-critical items include stretcher strap, spare torch and cab heater; cosmetic items include seat trim, locker latch and body scuff. It is also inferred from defects[].substitute_on_board and status open/closed. Closed defects stay in the list as decoys. defect_area appears as defects[].area. deferral_authorised appears as a defects[].deferral object {authorised_by, authorised_at, valid_until}, or null. deferral_invalid is shown only by comparison: valid_until before check.shift_date, or deferral.authorised_at after activity.first_mobilised_at. workshop_return_recent appears as an activity.workshop_jobs entry dated within 48 hours whose job_note says the same item was repaired, with no retest field. earliest_drug_expiry_days is rendered as an ISO expiry date in stock.lines, to be compared with check.shift_date. restock_in_progress appears as stock.restock_request with an eta inside the shift, or null. service_margin_km appears only as raw vehicle.odometer_km and vehicle.service_due_km. crew_note_tone shapes check.crew_note, for example 'Defib threw an error on start-up, sorted after battery reseat, self-test passed', or a terse note that downplays a real fault; it is null when absent. signed_after_mobilisation appears as check.signed_at later than activity.first_mobilised_at. repeat_defect_count appears as the number of activity.prior_checks entries listing the same item. Additional decoys: tyre pressures and fuel level are within normal range, and closed defects carry dramatic descriptions. No field may state readiness status, severity, limiting area, completeness level or whether defects are controlled. There must be no 'risk', 'priority' or 'fit_to_deploy' field. Free text is limited to check.crew_note, defects[].desc and activity.workshop_jobs[].job_note, each one sentence.

F212.role: Hearing bundle checker in a civil and family court listing office, reviewing each lodged bundle before it is released to the judge for pre-reading
F212.setting: Parties lodge electronic hearing bundles against case-management directions that set a lodging deadline, a page limit and a list of required documents. The checker opens one bundle record at a time, reconciles the directions, the lodgement details, the bundle index, the lodged files and the parties' confirmations, and decides whether the bundle can go to the judge, needs office correction, must wait for a party, or needs judicial direction.

directed_docs_covered.instructions: All directed documents are lodged or covered by recorded permission.

criteria.true: Each required document is lodged or has covering permission
criteria.false: A required document is absent with no valid permission

bundle_disposition.instructions: What should the bundle checker do with this bundle now?

criteria.accept: Nothing outstanding; bundle goes forward to the judge unchanged
criteria.accept_with_fixes: Only clerical defects the office can correct or annotate itself
criteria.hold: Items await party action; no judicial direction is needed
criteria.refer_judge: Missing directed material, unextended breach, or objection needs judicial direction

agreement_status.instructions: What is the parties' agreement status for the bundle contents?

criteria.agreed: Every party confirmed the lodged version with nothing disputed
criteria.agreed_subject: All parties confirmed, but disputed documents are listed separately
criteria.unilateral: A party has not confirmed and has lodged no objection
criteria.disputed: A party has recorded an objection to the bundle contents

index_mismatch.instructions: How many index entries disagree with the lodged files?
criteria: No index entry disagrees with the lodged files
Exactly one index entry disagrees with lodged files
Two to four index entries disagree with files
Five or more index entries disagree with files

lodging_lateness.instructions: How late was the bundle lodged against its effective deadline?
criteria: On time: lodged by the effective deadline
Slightly late: lodged one working day after effective deadline
Late: lodged two to four working days late
Very late: lodged five or more working days late

factors.name: index_discrepancy_count
factors.description: Number of index entries that disagree with lodged files (missing file, unindexed file, date differs, or page span differs from file page count)

factors.name: discrepancy_kind
factors.description: Typical form the discrepancies take: trivial date or one-page span slips versus substantive wrong-document or unindexed-file mismatches

factors.name: directed_doc_missing
factors.description: Whether one document required by directions has no matching lodged file

factors.name: late_doc_permission
factors.description: Recorded permission to lodge a required document late: none, covering the missing item, naming a different item, or expired before lodgement

factors.name: lodgement_offset_days
factors.description: Working days between the original deadline and the lodgement, negative when early

factors.name: deadline_extension
factors.description: Whether an order extended the lodging deadline by one to four working days

factors.name: after_hours_lodgement
factors.description: Whether the lodgement timestamp falls after the 16:00 court close, shifting it to the next working day

factors.name: confirmation_state
factors.description: Parties' confirmation of the bundle: all confirmed current version, one confirmed an earlier version only, one silent, or objection logged

factors.name: disputed_items_count
factors.description: Number of documents parties list as disputed in their confirmations

factors.name: page_ratio
factors.description: Total pages of lodged files divided by the original page limit

factors.name: page_extension_granted
factors.description: Whether an order raised the page limit for this hearing

factors.name: declared_total_mismatch
factors.description: Whether the lodging party's declared page total differs from the sum of file page counts

factors.name: days_to_hearing
factors.description: Calendar days from lodgement to the hearing date; adds pressure but decides no question alone

factors.name: hearing_type
factors.description: Kind of hearing, varying record shape and the documents directions require

sections.name: case
sections.description: Case number, jurisdiction, hearing type, hearing date, time estimate and judge tier

sections.name: directions
sections.description: Bundle deadline, page limit, required document refs and a list of later extension orders

sections.name: lodgement
sections.description: Lodging timestamp, lodging party, bundle version, declared page total and lodged files list

sections.name: index
sections.description: Bundle index entries with tab, doc ref, title, document date and page range

sections.name: parties
sections.description: Each party's role, representation, confirmed version, confirmation date, objection date and disputed refs

F212.rendering_notes: case: case_no, jurisdiction, hearing_type (hearing_type), hearing_date (lodgement date plus days_to_hearing), time_estimate_hrs, judge_tier; all decoys except hearing_date. directions: bundle_deadline (original ISO date), page_limit (integer), required_docs (list of doc_ref codes such as 'D07'), extensions (list of {type: 'deadline'|'pages'|'late_doc', ordered_on, new_deadline|new_limit|doc_ref+until}). deadline_extension adds a 'deadline' entry; page_extension_granted adds a 'pages' entry with new_limit set so roughly half of over-limit bundles become compliant; late_doc_permission adds a 'late_doc' entry whose doc_ref matches the missing item (covers_item), names another ref (covers_other_item), or has an until date before lodged_at (expired). lodgement: lodged_at (ISO datetime; after_hours_lodgement puts time after 16:00, counting as next working day), lodged_by, version (integer), declared_page_total (equals sum of file page_count unless declared_total_mismatch; this is a decoy for page checks, which use file counts), files (list of {doc_ref, doc_date, page_count}); directed_doc_missing removes one required ref from files. Lateness is computed in working days from the effective deadline (latest 'deadline' extension, else bundle_deadline) and the working-day-adjusted lodgement; weekends are skipped, so calendar gaps mislead. index: entries {tab, doc_ref, title, doc_date, pages_from, pages_to}; index_discrepancy_count mismatches are planted by discrepancy_kind: doc_date differs from file, span (pages_to - pages_from + 1) differs from file page_count, an index ref with no file, or a file with no index entry. Title wording or capitalisation differences between index and directions are decoys and never count. A missing directed document is not itself an index mismatch unless the index lists it. parties: list of {role, rep, confirmed_version, confirmed_on, objection_on, disputed_refs}; confirmation_state sets one party's confirmed_version below lodgement.version (one_stale, contested between agreed and unilateral), confirmed_version null with objection_on null (one_silent), or objection_on set (objection); disputed_items_count populates disputed_refs. No field may state readiness, lateness, mismatch counts, agreement status or a recommended action; no 'status', 'is_late', 'compliant' or 'ready' fields. Use null for unknown values, numbers as numbers, no free-text notes.

F213.domain: public swimming pool water testing logs
F213.role: Environmental health officer reviewing daily pool water testing logs submitted by public swimming pool operators
F213.setting: A local authority pool safety team receives one structured log per pool per operating day. Each log gathers the pool's limits and required test frequency, the poolside manual test entries, the automatic plant controller readings and dosing events, the test kit details, any corrective actions taken, and the state of the periodic microbiological sample. The officer reviews one log at a time. They decide whether testing was frequent enough, whether manual and controller readings agree, how quickly excursions were acted on, and what to do with the log. Many logs are clean. Others hide gaps, disagreements between sections, expired kits, late actions or pending lab results.

test_frequency_met.instructions: Tests were logged at the required frequency throughout opening hours.

criteria.true: Every required interval in opening hours has a test
criteria.false: At least one required interval lacks a logged test

readings_reconcile.instructions: Poolside chlorine and pH readings match the controller within tolerance.

log_disposition.instructions: What should the officer do with this day's log?

criteria.accept: Log complete and consistent; file without contacting the operator.
criteria.accept_with_query: Water quality acceptable, but a gap needs written operator explanation.
criteria.hold_for_retest: Outcome hinges on one pending lab result or confirming retest.
criteria.require_closure: Unsafe water evidenced and unresolved; pool closes until remedied.

action_delay.instructions: How long after the worst excursion was corrective action first logged?
criteria: None needed: no reading outside the pool's limits
Prompt: action logged within 30 minutes of excursion
Delayed: first action logged 30 to 120 minutes later
Unaddressed: no action logged, or over 120 minutes later

failed_checks.instructions: How many of the standard checks on this record failed?
criteria: No standard checks failed
Exactly one standard check failed
Two or three standard checks failed
Four or more standard checks failed

factors.name: pool_type
factors.description: Kind of pool. It sets the limits, the tolerances and the required manual test interval: spa hourly, the others every two hours.

factors.name: test_coverage_gap
factors.description: Number of required test intervals in opening hours with no manual test entry. A gap is shown only by the absence of an entry.

factors.name: boundary_interval
factors.description: One test falls exactly at the edge of its interval, for example 120 minutes after the previous one. This makes coverage arguable.

factors.name: log_controller_discrepancy
factors.description: Size of the largest disagreement between a manual reading and the controller reading nearest in time.

factors.name: discrepancy_location
factors.description: Which value carries the discrepancy. Temperature and timestamp offsets are decoys and do not count against reconciliation.

factors.name: excursion_severity
factors.description: Worst manual reading relative to the pool's limits. Ranges from none, through marginal or clear breaches, to a serious breach of free chlorine, pH or combined chlorine.

factors.name: corrective_action_delay
factors.description: Time from the worst excursion to the first corrective action entry.

factors.name: retest_logged
factors.description: Mitigation: a later manual retest shows the excursion was resolved. Present about half the time, so the same breach appears both resolved and unresolved.

factors.name: dosing_event_explains
factors.description: Mitigation: a shock dose or dilution logged before a combined chlorine rise accounts for it. Present about half the time.

factors.name: kit_calibration_status
factors.description: Calibration state on the log date of the test kit referenced by the manual entries.

factors.name: lab_sample_state
factors.description: State of the periodic microbiological sample. It is due when the pool's micro due date is on or before the log date.

factors.name: out_of_order_entry
factors.description: A timestamp sequence is impossible. Either a corrective action is time-stamped before the reading it responds to, or a lab result date precedes the sample date.

factors.name: benign_noise
factors.description: Alarming-looking but harmless detail. Examples: a high bather count, a routine backwash, a temperature swing within limits, or a reagent lot change.

sections.name: pool
sections.description: Pool identifier, type, volume, opening hours, test interval, limits and reconciliation tolerances, micro due date.

sections.name: manual_tests
sections.description: List of poolside entries: time, free_cl, combined_cl, ph, temp_c, water_clear, kit_id, tester_initials.

sections.name: plant
sections.description: Controller readings list (time, free_cl, ph, temp_c), dosing events list, backwash times, bather count.

sections.name: equipment
sections.description: Test kits list with kit_id, cal_due date and reagent_lot.

sections.name: actions
sections.description: Corrective actions list: time, action_type, reading_ref (time of the triggering test), retest_time.

sections.name: lab_sample
sections.description: Microbiology sample: sampled_on, result_on, status, tvc_37, coliforms, pseudomonas. Null when not taken.

F213.rendering_notes:
Field conventions: dates are ISO, times are ISO datetimes, concentrations are numbers in mg/l, unknowns are null.

Pool type. Shown by pool.type and pool.test_interval_min, alongside pool.limits {free_cl_min, free_cl_max, combined_cl_max, ph_min, ph_max} and pool.tolerance {free_cl, ph}.

Test coverage gap. Shown only by spacing between manual_tests times that exceeds test_interval_min within pool.opening {open, close}. No field ever counts gaps. For boundary_interval, place one gap exactly equal to the interval.

Log/controller discrepancy. Produced by setting the plant.controller_readings entry nearest in time to differ from the manual value by the sampled amount relative to pool.tolerance. Temperature and timestamp_offset placements (controller times shifted 10 to 20 minutes) are decoys and do not affect readings_reconcile.

Excursion severity. Appears only as raw values in manual_tests compared against pool.limits. A marginal breach is within 10% of the limit.

Corrective action delay. Rendered as the gap between actions.time and actions.reading_ref. If missing, the actions list is empty or has no entry referencing the excursion.

Retest logged. Appears as actions.retest_time plus a matching later manual_tests entry within limits.

Dosing event explains. Appears as a plant.dosing_events entry (shock or dilution) shortly before the combined_cl rise.

Kit calibration status. Compare manual_tests.kit_id against equipment.kits.cal_due and the log date. For kit_unlisted, the referenced kit_id is absent from equipment.

Lab sample state. Compare lab_sample against pool.micro_due. For missing_when_due, lab_sample is null although the due date has passed. For pending, result_on and the results are null. For positive, only the raw counts are shown.

Out-of-order entry. Shown purely through timestamps.

Benign noise. Appears in plant.bather_count, plant.backwash, temperature values or equipment.reagent_lot.

Prohibited fields. Never include compliance flags, status summaries, 'breach', 'risk', 'overdue', 'gap', delay minutes or recommended actions. Every answer must be derived by comparing fields across sections.

F214.role: Bridge inspection review engineer at a regional highways authority, checking each submitted inspection record before it is accepted into the structures asset register
F214.setting: Contract inspectors submit general and principal inspection records for highway bridges and culverts. The review engineer reads one record at a time. Each record contains the structure inventory, inspection details, element ratings with measured defects, a photo log, active restrictions and works, and short inspector remarks. The engineer decides whether the ratings agree with the measurements, whether any defect is actively growing, what happens to the record, how severe the worst defect is, and when the structure should next be inspected.

ratings_consistent.instructions: Element condition ratings agree with the logged defect measurements throughout.

active_deterioration.instructions: A recorded defect has grown beyond tolerance since the previous inspection.

criteria.true: Defect growth since prior record exceeds stated measurement tolerance.
criteria.false: Growth within tolerance, unmeasured, or no prior measurement exists.

record_disposition.instructions: What should happen to this inspection record next?

criteria.accept: Filed unchanged; next inspection at the standard routine interval.
criteria.accept_monitor: Filed, with an interim monitoring visit added before next interval.
criteria.hold_query: Filing paused pending one clarification or missing item from inspector.
criteria.reinspect: Record rejected; site visit repeated to re-measure or complete elements.
criteria.refer_restriction: Passed to structures engineer to assess load or lane restriction.

defect_severity.instructions: How severe is the worst confirmed defect on the structure?
criteria: No defect beyond surface staining or hairline cracking.
Cracking or spalling, no reinforcement or steel exposed.
Steel exposed, section loss below ten per cent.
Section loss of ten per cent or more.

next_inspection.instructions: How soon should the next inspection of this structure occur?
criteria: Standard: at the routine 24-month interval.
Shortened: within 12 months of this inspection.
Early: within 6 months of this inspection.
Priority: within 4 weeks of this inspection.
Immediate: within 7 days of this inspection.

factors.name: structure_type
factors.description: Form of the bridge, which determines element list, typical defects and how section loss is expressed

factors.name: worst_defect_band
factors.description: True severity of the worst defect as shown by the measurements, before any rating or mitigation is considered

factors.name: reconciliation_gap
factors.description: Size of the mismatch between corresponding values in different sections; never flagged in the record

factors.name: gap_location
factors.description: Where the mismatch sits when one exists

factors.name: growth_vs_tolerance
factors.description: Change in worst defect size against the prior measurement, relative to the stated measurement tolerance

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: Whether a field lowers concern about the alarming defect; sampled independently of severity

factors.name: mitigation_type
factors.description: Form of mitigation when present

factors.name: access_limited
factors.description: Some elements were not inspected because of water level, possession refusal or traffic management

factors.name: photo_coverage
factors.description: Whether the worst defect is evidenced by a matching photo

factors.name: remark_tone
factors.description: Wording of the inspector remark, which may sound more or less alarming than the measurements

factors.name: months_since_prior
factors.description: Interval since the previous inspection, used to judge growth rate and overdue status

factors.name: boundary_value
factors.description: A key measurement sits exactly on a scale threshold, such as 10 per cent section loss or growth equal to tolerance

factors.name: route_class
factors.description: Class of carried road, affecting how quickly restriction or inspection is warranted

sections.name: structure
sections.description: Inventory: str_id, name, type, spans, route_class, element_ids list, year_built

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: insp_date, insp_type, inspector_ref, prior_insp_date, access_notes, elements_not_inspected list, tol_mm

sections.name: elements
sections.description: List of element_id, cond_rating 1-5, defects list with type, size_mm, prior_size_mm, loss_pct, photo_ref

sections.name: photo_log
sections.description: List of photo_ref, element_id, taken_date, caption (one short sentence)

sections.name: restrictions_works
sections.description: Active weight or lane restrictions, temporary works, works orders with planned dates, monitoring sensors

sections.name: notes
sections.description: inspector_remark and prior_report_extract, one or two sentences each; optional next_insp_proposed_months

F214.rendering_notes: worst_defect_band appears only as size_mm, loss_pct and defect type in elements.defects; never as a severity label. reconciliation_gap and gap_location appear as a disagreement between sections. Examples include a cond_rating of 2 beside loss_pct 12, a caption saying spall where the defect says crack, a defect element_id absent from structure.element_ids, a prior_insp_date later than insp_date, or a remark naming a defect not listed. Trivial gaps are mm against cm, or 0.3 against 0.25 within rounding. growth_vs_tolerance comes from size_mm minus prior_size_mm compared with inspection.tol_mm; no_prior_measurement means prior_size_mm is null. A boundary case puts growth exactly at tol_mm or loss_pct exactly at 10. Mitigation appears in restrictions_works (restriction, propping, works order dated within months) or in prior_report_extract (defect noted as historic and assessed, or staining traced to a drainage outlet). Mitigation is sampled at 0.5, so the same severe defect appears with and without it. Mitigation can lower next_inspection and disposition, but never changes defect_severity or ratings_consistent. access_limited fills elements_not_inspected and access_notes, and favours hold_query or reinspect depending on whether critical elements were missed. Missing photos for the worst defect favour hold_query. Decoys: remark_tone wording can be alarming without measurement or reassuring despite large loss_pct. next_insp_proposed_months, when present in about half of records, is the inspector's own view and is sometimes wrong. year_built and route_class add context but do not settle answers alone. No field may state a disposition, a severity band, a growth verdict, a consistency flag or the review engineer's interval. Records use numbers as numbers, ISO dates and null for unmeasured values.

F215.domain: grain store temperature and moisture monitoring
F215.role: Grain storage supervisor at an arable co-operative's central store, reviewing one bin's weekly monitoring snapshot at a time
F215.setting: A co-operative runs a site of flat stores and silo bins holding wheat, barley, oilseed rape and beans. Every bin carries temperature cables, logs fan runs and gets periodic moisture samples and pest trap checks. Each week the supervisor opens one bin's snapshot. They decide whether a real heating spot is forming, whether moisture is within the crop's safe limit, what to do with the bin next, and how far the hottest valid reading sits above the bin's baseline.

hotspot_active.instructions: A genuine heating hotspot is developing within the stored grain.

criteria.true: Rising valid readings, corroborated, not explained by ambient warming
criteria.false: Readings stable, explained, faulty, or not corroborated elsewhere

moisture_safe.instructions: Grain moisture is within the safe storage limit for its crop.

criteria.true: Latest verified sample at or below crop safe limit
criteria.false: Above limit, unverified, overdue, or sample missing

next_action.instructions: What should the supervisor do with this bin next?

criteria.continue_monitoring: Leave as is; routine readings continue on normal schedule
criteria.hold_recheck: Resample or recheck cables before deciding on any intervention
criteria.aerate: Run aeration fans to cool or dry grain in place
criteria.turn_or_unload: Move grain out of the bin to break heating

recurrence_count.instructions: How often has this same issue been logged in 12 months?
criteria: First occurrence; not logged in prior 12 months
Logged once before within the past 12 months
Logged two to four times in 12 months
Logged five or more times in 12 months

temp_excess.instructions: How far does the peak valid temperature exceed bin baseline?
criteria: Peak valid reading at most 2°C above baseline
Peak over 2°C, up to 5°C above baseline
Peak over 5°C, up to 10°C above baseline
Peak more than 10°C above baseline

factors.name: peak_excess_c
factors.description: True rise of the hottest valid cable node over the bin baseline, in °C. Values cluster near the 2, 5 and 10 boundaries often enough to create borderline cases.

factors.name: rise_trend
factors.description: Shape of the hottest node across the last three weekly readings: flat, single jump, or steady climb.

factors.name: second_cable_corroboration
factors.description: Whether an adjacent cable or node also shows the rise. Without it, a rise on one node is only a possible hotspot.

factors.name: sensor_fault_flag
factors.description: Whether the cable carrying the highest raw reading is flagged faulty or has an expired calibration date, which makes that spike a decoy.

factors.name: ambient_warming
factors.description: Whether a recent warm spell lifted the headspace and only the top node, a benign explanation for surface warming.

factors.name: moisture_vs_limit
factors.description: Where the true grain moisture sits relative to the crop's safe storage limit.

factors.name: moisture_sample_status
factors.description: Quality and recency of the latest moisture evidence. A handheld-only reading near the limit is unverified; an overdue or missing sample cannot support a safe claim.

factors.name: aeration_running
factors.description: Whether a fan run is already logged as in progress with hours accumulating. This mitigates warming but leaves the work unfinished.

factors.name: co2_elevation
factors.description: Headspace CO2 relative to normal. Elevated CO2 indirectly corroborates biological heating from insects or mould.

factors.name: insect_trap_count
factors.description: Insects counted across probe traps at the latest check. Counts are a secondary heating driver.

factors.name: missing_section
factors.description: Which part of the snapshot is absent or null: some cable nodes unread, fan log null, or the moisture block null.

factors.name: date_order_anomaly
factors.description: Whether a moisture sample date precedes the bin intake date, which voids that sample as evidence for the current grain.

factors.name: intake_condition
factors.description: How the grain went in: dried and cleaned, undried, or blended from several loads. Undried or blended intake raises baseline risk.

sections.name: bin
sections.description: Bin identity and contents: bin_id, crop, fill_t, capacity_t, intake_date, intake_cond, safe_mc_pct, baseline_c.

sections.name: cable_readings
sections.description: List of cables, each with cable_id, cal_due, fault, and nodes of depth_m with temp_c for the last three dates.

sections.name: moisture
sections.description: Sample list of sample_date, method (lab or handheld), mc_pct; may be null or empty.

sections.name: environment
sections.description: Site conditions: ambient_c_7d_mean, headspace_c, co2_ppm, reading_date.

sections.name: aeration
sections.description: Fan log list of start, end (null if running), fan_hours, mode; may be null.

sections.name: pest_checks
sections.description: Trap checks with check_date, traps_set, insects_counted; may be empty.

F215.rendering_notes: peak_excess_c is never stated. The reader computes it by comparing the hottest node on non-faulty, in-calibration cables against bin.baseline_c. When sensor_fault_flag is true, a cable with fault=true or a past cal_due holds the highest raw temp_c as a decoy, while the valid peak sits lower. rise_trend shows across the three dated temp_c values per node. second_cable_corroboration shows as whether a neighbouring cable's nodes at similar depth also rise. ambient_warming shows as environment.ambient_c_7d_mean and headspace_c well above baseline_c, with only the top node elevated. moisture_vs_limit is shown by the latest moisture.mc_pct against bin.safe_mc_pct. moisture_sample_status shows through method, through sample_date age against environment.reading_date (over 30 days is overdue), or through an empty list. date_order_anomaly shows as a sample_date earlier than bin.intake_date. aeration_running shows as a fan_log entry with end null and fan_hours > 0. missing_section renders as the named block set to null, or as cable nodes with temp_c null. co2_elevation renders as co2_ppm values (around 400-600 normal, 800-1500 raised, above 1500 high). insect_trap_count renders as pest_checks.insects_counted. intake_condition renders as bin.intake_cond. Decoys: the faulty cable spike, a warm headspace, and a high trap count with flat temperatures. Records carry no free-text fields and no derived fields such as risk, status, hotspot, safe, alert or recommended_action. No answer to any question is ever written into the record.

F216.role: Cold-chain lead pharmacist for a regional immunisation service, reviewing each completed vaccination session log before stock is released, quarantined or destroyed
F216.setting: After every vaccination session (fixed clinic, outreach coolbox run, school session or community pharmacy), the session's cold-chain log is exported from the clinic system and lands in the lead pharmacist's review queue. Each record combines the session header, the storage unit details, the temperature readings from the data logger and the manual checks, the stock movements by lot, the administration list, and any excursion actions taken. The pharmacist decides whether doses were given from compromised stock, whether stock reconciles, what happens to the remaining stock, how long it was out of range and how soon follow-up is needed. Nothing in the record states these answers; they must be worked out by comparing sections.

dosed_uncleared.instructions: Doses were given from stock while an excursion remained uncleared.

criteria.true: Administration times fall after excursion start, before any clearance.
criteria.false: No doses during exposure, or clearance preceded use.

stock_reconciles.instructions: Closing stock count reconciles with opening stock, doses given and wasted.

criteria.true: Counts balance per lot and lot numbers match.
criteria.false: Count gap or lot mismatch between sections.

stock_disposition.instructions: What should happen to the vaccine stock from this session?

criteria.release: No qualifying excursion; stock returns to normal use unchanged.
criteria.release_restricted: Excursion cleared by manufacturer advice with shortened use-by date.
criteria.quarantine_hold: Exposure unresolved; stock held pending stability advice or confirmation.
criteria.partial_discard: Some lots exceed tolerance; destroy those, keep the rest.
criteria.discard_all: Every lot in the unit exceeded tolerance; destroy all.

excursion_duration.instructions: How long did stock spend outside 2–8 °C in total?
criteria: None: no product reading outside 2–8 °C
Brief: under 30 cumulative minutes outside range
Extended: 30 to 120 cumulative minutes outside range
Prolonged: over 120 cumulative minutes outside range

followup_urgency.instructions: How soon must follow-up action on this session be taken?
criteria: Routine filing only; no further action needed
Action due before the next scheduled session
Action due within 24 hours of review
Same-day action; affected patients may need recall

factors.name: true_excursion_minutes
factors.description: Actual cumulative minutes the product (buffered) probe was outside 2–8 °C. Never stated; must be summed from temp_log.readings intervals and cross-checked against manual checks.

factors.name: log_source_discrepancy
factors.description: How the data logger and manual check sheet disagree: none, a small calibration offset, missing manual checks, or a logger gap where only manual readings bound the excursion.

factors.name: buffered_probe_in_range
factors.description: Mitigation: an air-probe spike appears, but the buffered product probe stayed within range throughout, so the alarm does not reflect product temperature.

factors.name: planned_maintenance
factors.description: Mitigation decoy: a scheduled defrost or unit relocation is recorded overlapping the alarm window, with stock moved to a validated backup unit or coolbox whose readings are present.

factors.name: stability_clearance
factors.description: Status of manufacturer or regional stability advice for the exposure: not requested, requested and pending, cleared with full expiry, cleared with shortened expiry, or refused.

factors.name: doses_during_exposure
factors.description: Number of administration entries timestamped between excursion start and clearance time (or session end if never cleared). Zero in many records.

factors.name: stock_count_gap
factors.description: Opening minus administered minus wasted, compared with closing count, summed across lots. Zero means balanced; non-zero values range from one dose to several.

factors.name: lot_id_mismatch
factors.description: An administration entry cites a lot number absent from stock.lots, or differing by one character from a listed lot.

factors.name: lots_beyond_tolerance
factors.description: Which lots exceeded their product-specific excursion tolerance (lots stored on different shelves or in a coolbox see different exposure): none, some, or all.

factors.name: freezing_reading
factors.description: At least one product-probe reading at or below 0 °C, which voids tolerance for freeze-sensitive products regardless of duration.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Cumulative excursion falls within 3 minutes of 30 or 120, or the peak reading is exactly 8.0 °C, or logger and manual sources place the total on opposite sides of a threshold.

factors.name: unit_alarm_history
factors.description: Count of alarms on this storage unit in the previous 30 days; a decoy for repeated faults that raises attention but does not itself decide disposition.

factors.name: session_type
factors.description: Kind of session, which changes how the record looks (coolbox outreach has transport legs and no fridge door events; pharmacy has a single fridge).

sections.name: session
sections.description: Session id, site code, session_type, date, start and end times, next_session_date.

sections.name: storage
sections.description: Unit id, unit_type, probe config, last_calibration date, alarms_30d count, maintenance entries with start and end times.

sections.name: temp_log
sections.description: Logger readings list (time, air_c, product_c), manual_checks list (time, min_c, max_c, current_c), logger_gaps list.

sections.name: stock
sections.description: Lots list with lot_no, product, shelf, expiry, tolerance_min_out, freeze_sensitive, opening, wasted, closing.

sections.name: administration
sections.description: List of dose entries with time, lot_no and dose count.

sections.name: excursion_actions
sections.description: Excursion start and end, quarantined boolean, advice_requested_at, advice_status code, advice_received_at, revised_expiry or null.

F216.rendering_notes: true_excursion_minutes is never stated: the reader sums intervals where temp_log.readings.product_c is outside 2.0–8.0, using the 5- or 10-minute logging interval; excursion_actions.start and end are entered by clinic staff and may disagree with the readings (S1). log_source_discrepancy: minor_offset shows manual current_c 0.3–0.6 °C off logger values; manual_checks_missing leaves required checks absent; logger_gap lists a gap in temp_log.logger_gaps, with only manual min_c/max_c bracketing it, so duration is uncertain (S6). buffered_probe_in_range: air_c spikes above 8 while product_c stays in range; when false, product_c follows the spike. If storage.probe_config is 'air_only', there is no product_c and air readings must be treated as product temperature. planned_maintenance: storage.maintenance lists a defrost or relocation overlapping the spike, and a backup unit id appears with its own readings; whether the backup readings were in range still has to be checked. stability_clearance appears only as excursion_actions.advice_status codes (NR, PEND, CLR, CLR_SHORT, REF) with timestamps; revised_expiry populated only for CLR_SHORT. doses_during_exposure is found by comparing administration times with excursion start and advice_received_at. stock_count_gap appears only through per-lot opening, wasted, closing and summed administration doses. lot_id_mismatch shows as an administration lot_no missing from stock.lots or one character different. lots_beyond_tolerance is shown via shelf positions and the coolbox leg each lot occupied against tolerance_min_out per lot. freezing_reading shows as a product_c value at or below 0.0 for a freeze_sensitive lot. Decoys: storage.alarms_30d, an old last_calibration date, air_c spikes with in-range product_c, maintenance entries that do not actually overlap, and wasted doses recorded for opened vials, which are legitimate. The record must never contain fields such as compromised, risk, severity, excursion_minutes_total, disposition, reconciled or urgency; it contains no free-text notes, only codes, numbers, timestamps, booleans and null for unknown values.

F217.role: Venue technical manager reviewing each rigging inspection record before signing off flying equipment for an incoming production's get-in
F217.setting: A mid-sized receiving theatre keeps one record per rigging item (counterweight sets, chain hoists, hemp sets, truss sections, flying tracks). Each record combines the asset register entry, the current examination certificate, the latest periodic inspection, the incoming production's load plan for that item, and any maintenance history. The technical manager reads one record at a time, compares sections against each other, and decides whether the item can be used, under what restriction, and what is holding it back.

load_within_swl.instructions: Planned production load stays within the currently verified safe working load.

signoff.instructions: What sign-off should this rigging item receive before the get-in?

criteria.approve: Cleared for use as planned with no further action needed.
criteria.approve_conditional: Cleared only with a recorded restriction, such as reduced load.
criteria.hold_pending: Not used until one outstanding check or document is received.
criteria.withdraw: Taken out of service until repaired and formally re-examined.

limiting_issue.instructions: Which single issue most limits this item's readiness for service?

criteria.no_issue: No defect, gap, lapse or load conflict found in record.
criteria.paperwork_gap: Certificate, serial, check result or dates missing or inconsistent only.
criteria.exam_lapsed: Thorough examination expiry falls before or on the get-in date.
criteria.component_wear: Measured wear, corrosion or damage recorded on a physical component.
criteria.overload: Planned load exceeds the safe working load verified for item.

defect_severity.instructions: How severe is the worst recorded defect on this item?
criteria: None: no defect recorded on any checked component
Cosmetic: surface marks only, no measured section loss
Degraded: measured wear below discard limit, needs monitoring
Discard: measurement at or beyond stated discard limit

checklist_completion.instructions: How complete is the required inspection checklist for this item?
criteria: No required check has a recorded result
Some checks recorded, two or more still missing
Exactly one required check still lacks a result
Every required check has a recorded result

factors.name: load_margin_ratio
factors.description: Ratio of planned total load (bar weight plus listed items) to the verified safe working load; values near 1.0 create boundary cases.

factors.name: swl_discrepancy
factors.description: How the safe working load in the asset register differs from the certificate or a later derating in maintenance.

factors.name: worst_defect
factors.description: Worst physical condition found, expressed through measured wear against the discard limit on the certificate.

factors.name: defect_in_note_only
factors.description: A defect is described in the inspector's free-text note but absent from the structured defects list.

factors.name: checks_outstanding
factors.description: Number of required check codes with no result or absent from the inspection checks list.

factors.name: exam_status
factors.description: Thorough examination expiry relative to the production's get-in date.

factors.name: repair_status
factors.description: State of any repair raised against the item: none needed, open, done without retest, or done and retested.

factors.name: mitigation_present
factors.description: A mitigating fact accompanies the alarming signal: signed competent-person extension, approved derating with reduced load, secondary suspension fitted, or retest passed after repair.

factors.name: date_order_error
factors.description: Dates out of sequence, such as retest dated before repair completion or inspection dated after get-in.

factors.name: certificate_missing
factors.description: Certification section is null or lacks a certificate reference.

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: One deciding value sits exactly on a scale edge, e.g. load ratio 0.99 to 1.01 or wear equal to discard limit within rounding.

factors.name: decoy_note
factors.description: Alarming-sounding but irrelevant free text, e.g. a crew complaint about a squeaking pulley already logged cleared.

factors.name: item_type
factors.description: Kind of rigging item, changing which checks and measurements appear.

sections.name: asset
sections.description: Register entry: asset_id, item_type, serial_no, location, swl_kg, required_checks list of codes.

sections.name: certification
sections.description: Thorough examination certificate: cert_ref, serial_no, swl_kg or swl_lbs, exam_date, expiry_date, discard_limits, extension_ref; may be null.

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: Latest periodic inspection: insp_date, inspector_id, checks list of code and result, defects list with measured values, inspector_note.

sections.name: load_plan
sections.description: Incoming production: production_code, getin_date, bar_weight_kg, items list of desc and kg, secondary_suspension, production_note.

sections.name: maintenance
sections.description: Work orders list: wo_id, raised, completed, retest_date, retest_result, derated_swl_kg, derate_approved_by, note.

F217.rendering_notes: Verified SWL is the lowest of certification.swl_kg (convert swl_lbs where used) and any maintenance.derated_swl_kg; load_margin_ratio is rendered only as bar_weight_kg plus load_plan.items kg, never as a ratio. swl_discrepancy shows as asset.swl_kg differing from certificate or derate, or asset.serial_no differing from certification.serial_no. worst_defect is shown as inspection.defects measured_pct against certification.discard_limits, never as a severity label; when defect_in_note_only is true the defect appears only in inspection.inspector_note text. checks_outstanding is the count of asset.required_checks codes missing from inspection.checks or with result null. exam_status is derived by comparing certification.expiry_date with load_plan.getin_date. repair_status shows via maintenance completed and retest_date null or set. mitigation_present renders as certification.extension_ref with signer, maintenance.derate_approved_by with reduced load, load_plan.secondary_suspension true, or retest_result pass; it appears with and without each alarming signal about equally. date_order_error appears as retest_date earlier than completed or insp_date later than getin_date. certificate_missing sets certification to null. Decoys sit in maintenance.note and load_plan.production_note (cleared complaints, references to other asset_ids, paint comments). Free text limited to inspector_note, production_note and work order notes, one sentence each. No field states fitness, severity, sign-off, completeness or limiting issue; numbers are numbers, dates ISO, unknowns null.

F218.domain: tree felling licence applications to a forestry authority
F218.role: Felling licence officer at a regional forestry authority, determining one tree felling licence application at a time
F218.setting: A forestry authority receives applications to fell trees on private and public holdings. Each application lists the compartments to be felled, the claimed ownership or consent, the restocking proposal and known site constraints, and may carry the officer's own site check. The officer cross-checks the sections against each other, weighs alarming constraints against evidence that lowers concern, and decides how to proceed.

consent_established.instructions: Owner or consent to fell is evidenced for every compartment.

criteria.true: Every listed compartment matches current title or consent
criteria.false: A compartment lacks matching, current ownership or consent evidence

disposition.instructions: What should the officer do with this application now?

criteria.approve: All checks pass; licence issued without additional conditions.
criteria.approve_conditions: Acceptable only if bound by restocking, timing or species conditions.
criteria.hold: One curable missing item or confirmation blocks determination.
criteria.refuse: Incurable defect such as no consent or unmitigated harm.

consultation_tier.instructions: Which highest consultation tier must precede determining this application?

criteria.none: No designation, species finding or area threshold is engaged.
criteria.internal_review: Species finding or adjoining designation, checked by in-house ecologist.
criteria.statutory_consultee: Felling inside a designation, conservation area or tree order.
criteria.public_register: Total felled area at or above 5 ha, listed publicly.

discrepancy_size.instructions: How far does the recorded value differ from the expected value?
criteria: Matches expected value, or differs by under 2%
Differs from expected value by 2% to under 10%
Differs from expected value by 10% to under 25%
Differs from expected value by 25% or more

restock_shortfall.instructions: How large is the restocking shortfall against the felled area?
criteria: Restocking area meets or exceeds felled area
Shortfall below 10% of felled area
Shortfall from 10% to 30% of felled area
Shortfall above 30%, or no restocking proposed

factors.name: consent_coverage
factors.description: Whether every compartment in the proposal is matched by a current title or consent record in the holding section; failures are never flagged, only visible by comparing ids, dates and ownership basis

factors.name: area_discrepancy_pct
factors.description: Percentage difference between the applicant's compartment area and the officer's measured area in the site check

factors.name: volume_discrepancy_pct
factors.description: Percentage difference between declared timber volume and the site check estimate; often a decoy unrelated to the disposition

factors.name: restocking_shortfall_band
factors.description: How the proposed restocking area compares with the total felled area, including cases with no restocking block at all

factors.name: restock_exemption
factors.description: Whether a valid restocking exemption applies (dangerous trees, approved conversion to open habitat), which makes a shortfall acceptable for disposition though the shortfall score still reflects the raw gap

factors.name: designation_status
factors.description: Relationship of the felling site to statutory designations and protected-tree orders

factors.name: designation_mitigation
factors.description: Prior written agreement from the relevant consultee or an approved woodland management plan covering the compartments is on file

factors.name: species_signal
factors.description: State of the protected species evidence for the site

factors.name: felled_area_total_ha
factors.description: Total area to be felled across all compartments; values near 5 ha are frequent so the public register threshold is often on the boundary, especially when applicant and measured areas straddle it

factors.name: missing_items
factors.description: Count of required supporting documents absent from the documents list (map, species survey, consent letter, restocking map)

factors.name: timing_conflict
factors.description: Whether the proposed felling window overlaps the bird nesting season set in constraints, or the restock-by date precedes the felling end date

factors.name: prior_breach_count
factors.description: Number of previous unlicensed felling notices against the applicant; alarming but often paired with resolution evidence

factors.name: prior_breach_resolved
factors.description: Whether earlier breach notices were closed with restocking verified; sampled independently of breach count

factors.name: days_to_deadline
factors.description: Days remaining until the statutory determination date; a decoy that adds pressure but decides none of the questions

sections.name: application
sections.description: Reference, received and determination dates, applicant type, agent, prior notices and attached documents list

sections.name: holding
sections.description: List of title or consent records with compartment ids, basis, holder and expiry

sections.name: felling
sections.description: List of compartments with id, area_ha, species, felling_type, tree_count, volume_m3 and proposed window dates

sections.name: restocking
sections.description: Proposed restock area, species mix, restock-by date and exemption code or null

sections.name: constraints
sections.description: Designations list, tree order and conservation area flags, nesting season dates, species survey date and result

sections.name: site_check
sections.description: Officer inspection date, measured area_ha, estimated volume_m3 and tree count, or null if not inspected

F218.rendering_notes: consent_coverage appears only by comparing felling[].cpt_id with holding[].cpt_ids, holding[].basis (freehold, lease, consent_letter), holding[].expiry against application.received, and holding[].landlord_consent_ref (null for tenant_no_landlord_consent); id_typo_only renders a near-identical id such as C-07 vs C07 that a sensible judge may accept. area_discrepancy_pct is the gap between sum of felling[].area_ha and site_check.area_ha; volume_discrepancy_pct between felling[].volume_m3 and site_check.volume_m3. felled_area_total_ha is never given as a total; it must be summed, and in boundary records the applicant sum and measured area fall either side of 5.0. restocking_shortfall_band shows as restocking.area_ha against the felled sum; no_plan renders restocking.area_ha as null with species []. restock_exemption renders as restocking.exemption_code (e.g. DT2, OHC1) with a matching felling_type or as null. designation_status appears in constraints.designations[] (each with type and relation: within or adjoining), constraints.tree_order and constraints.conservation_area booleans. designation_mitigation renders as constraints.consultee_agreement_ref or holding[].mgmt_plan_ref, null when absent. species_signal uses constraints.species_survey {date, result: clear|roost|null, mitigation_plan_ref}; out of date means survey date more than 24 months before received. missing_items is visible only by comparing application.documents[] with what the case requires. timing_conflict is visible by comparing felling[].window_start/window_end with constraints.nesting_start/nesting_end and restocking.restock_by. prior_breach_count and prior_breach_resolved render as application.prior_notices[] with status open or closed and restock_verified booleans. Decoys: volume discrepancies, days_to_deadline via application.determine_by, tree_count differences, agent presence, species mix details. Never include fields naming the answer: no consent_ok, recommended_decision, consultation_tier, shortfall_band, risk or priority fields. Dates ISO, areas and volumes as numbers, unknowns as null; no free-text fields.

F219.role: Port catch verification officer at a fisheries monitoring centre, reviewing one vessel landing declaration at a time against port weighing, logbook, satellite tracking and quota records before the catch is released for first sale
F219.setting: A coastal fisheries authority requires every licensed vessel to lodge a landing declaration after each trip. The officer sees the declaration together with the vessel's licence and inspection history, the trip logbook and tracking summary, the port weighing record, the stock-by-stock quota ledger and the dispatch schedule for the catch. The officer must decide whether the figures hold, how the landing sits against quota, how late the paperwork was, how urgently the catch must be checked and what happens next.

within_tolerance.instructions: Every declared species weight is within 10% of its port-weighed weight.

disposition.instructions: What should happen to this landing declaration next?

criteria.clear_release: Accept the declaration as filed and release catch for sale.
criteria.amend_and_release: Vessel corrects declared figures; catch released once amendment lodged.
criteria.hold_for_document: Keep catch in port until one outstanding confirmation arrives.
criteria.reinspect_catch: Inspector re-weighs or physically examines the catch before release.
criteria.refer_infringement: Pass the file to enforcement for suspected infringement proceedings.

quota_standing.instructions: How does this landing stand against the vessel's quota allocation?

criteria.within_allocation: Landing fits inside remaining base quota plus approved swaps.
criteria.covered_by_banked: Exceeds base and approved swaps; banked carry-over covers the excess.
criteria.swap_pending: Excess is covered only by a swap still awaiting approval.
criteria.uncovered_overrun: Excess exceeds base, banked and all swap quota combined.

submission_lateness.instructions: How late was the landing declaration lodged after landing completed?
criteria: Prompt: lodged under 24 hours after landing completion
Late: lodged 24 hours or more, under 72
Overdue: lodged 72 hours or more after landing
Outstanding: no declaration lodged by time of review

dispatch_urgency.instructions: How urgently must this catch be checked before onward dispatch?
criteria: Catch held in port store beyond 72 hours
Dispatch scheduled between 24 and 72 hours away
Dispatch scheduled between 6 and 24 hours away
Dispatch scheduled under 6 hours from review
Catch already dispatched before review began

factors.name: max_species_variance_pct
factors.description: Largest absolute percentage gap between a declared species weight and its port-weighed weight; clustered values between 8 and 12 create boundary cases around the 10% margin

factors.name: weighing_status
factors.description: Whether port weighing covers every declared species, only some of them, or is missing entirely

factors.name: undeclared_species_present
factors.description: Port weighing records a species line that does not appear in the declaration

factors.name: ice_basis_explains_variance
factors.description: Mitigation: weighing done on gross basis with no ice deduction applied, so a positive variance is attributable to ice rather than under-declaration

factors.name: quota_headroom_pct
factors.description: Remaining base quota for the main stock minus the landed weight, as a percentage of the landing; negative means the landing exceeds base quota

factors.name: banked_kg
factors.description: Carry-over quota banked from the previous year for the main stock, which may or may not cover a base overrun

factors.name: swap_status
factors.description: State of any inbound quota swap for the main stock: none, requested but unapproved, or approved

factors.name: declaration_submitted
factors.description: Whether a declaration has been lodged at all; when false the declaration section is null

factors.name: submission_delay_hours
factors.description: Hours between landing completion and declaration lodgement, with values clustered near 24 and 72

factors.name: hours_to_dispatch
factors.description: Hours from review time until the catch leaves port; negative means already dispatched

factors.name: vms_area_status
factors.description: Whether tracking positions agree with logbook catch areas, disagree with a logged transponder outage, or disagree with no explanation

factors.name: date_sequence_error
factors.description: Recorded timestamps are out of order, such as landing completion before port arrival or a haul ending after arrival

factors.name: prior_infringements_24m
factors.description: Count of confirmed infringements in the past 24 months; context and decoy, never decisive alone

factors.name: recent_clean_inspection
factors.description: Mitigation: a physical inspection within the last 90 days found no issues

sections.name: vessel
sections.description: Vessel identity, licence, size, infringement count and last inspection outcome

sections.name: trip
sections.description: Departure and arrival times, logbook hauls with areas, tracking summary

sections.name: declaration
sections.description: Lodgement time, landing completion time and declared species lines; null if not lodged

sections.name: port_weighing
sections.description: Weighing status, weigh basis, ice deduction flag and weighed species lines

sections.name: quota_position
sections.description: Per-stock base remaining, banked carry-over and swap entries with status

sections.name: dispatch
sections.description: Storage location, scheduled onward departure and actual departure time

F219.rendering_notes: vessel: {vessel_id, flag, length_m, licence_ref, infringements_24m (prior_infringements_24m), last_inspection: {date, result} where recent_clean_inspection gives a date within 90 days of review and result 'no_issues', otherwise an older date or result 'issues_found'}. trip: {departed_at, arrived_at, hauls: [{haul_no, area, haul_end}], vms: {areas_visited: [..], outage_logged: bool}}; vms_area_status shows only by comparing hauls[].area with vms.areas_visited, with outage_logged true for mismatch_explained and false for the other two. date_sequence_error places landing_completed_at before arrived_at or a haul_end after arrived_at. declaration: null when declaration_submitted is false; otherwise {submitted_at, landing_completed_at, lines: [{species, kg, area, presentation}]}; submission_delay_hours is only derivable as submitted_at minus landing_completed_at (when declaration is null, landing_completed_at moves to port_weighing.landing_completed_at). port_weighing: null when weighing_status is absent; otherwise {status: 'complete'|'partial', weigh_basis: 'net'|'gross', ice_deduction_applied: bool, lines: [{species, kg}]}; partial omits one or more declared species; max_species_variance_pct is realised only through paired kg values, never as a percentage field; undeclared_species_present adds an extra weighed species; ice_basis_explains_variance sets weigh_basis 'gross' with ice_deduction_applied false and weighed kg above declared. Within_tolerance is true only when weighing is complete, no undeclared species appear and every pair is within 10% on the recorded figures; partial or absent weighing makes it false because the claim is unsupported. quota_position: {stocks: [{stock, base_remaining_kg, banked_kg, swaps: [{swap_ref, kg, status}]}]}; quota_headroom_pct is derived against summed declared (or weighed) kg for that stock; the officer must add approved swaps, then banked, then pending swaps to place the landing; set cases where banked exactly matches the excess, or where a swap is approved with a date after landing, to produce contested judgments. dispatch: {storage: 'port_cold_store'|'quay'|'vehicle', scheduled_departure, departed_at (null unless already gone)}; hours_to_dispatch is computed from a review_at timestamp in the record header versus scheduled_departure or departed_at. Disposition guidance: clear_release when nothing is unresolved; amend_and_release when variance is explained by ice basis or is a clerical figure error with no other issue; hold_for_document when exactly one confirmation is outstanding (pending swap, partial weighing, unlodged declaration, explained VMS gap awaiting outage report); reinspect_catch when unexplained variance over 10% or an undeclared species exists and catch is still in port; refer_infringement for uncovered overrun, unexplained VMS mismatch alongside other issues, date sequence error with discrepancies, or dispatched catch with unresolved variance. Prior infringements and a clean recent inspection shift borderline cases only. Decoys: flag, length_m, presentation codes, haul counts, storage type and infringement count. Never include fields such as variance_pct, within_tolerance, quota_status, late_flag, urgency or recommended_action; no free-text notes anywhere.

F220.role: Sterile services release checker reviewing each processed instrument tray record before it is released to theatre
F220.setting: A hospital sterile services department reprocesses reusable surgical instrument trays. Each tray passes through washer-disinfection, inspection and packing against a set list, then steam sterilisation in a porous-load autoclave. Before a tray goes to the theatre store, a release checker opens its tracking record. The record holds the tray identity and theatre request, the packing count, the washer cycle, the steriliser load with its indicators, and the printed release label. The checker decides whether the cycle data hold up, what happens to the tray, where the earliest unresolved problem sits, how many instrument discrepancies are unexplained, and how much doubt there is over sterility assurance.

cycle_in_limits.instructions: Cycle parameters stayed within validated limits throughout the hold period.

criteria.true: logged temperature, pressure and hold time all in band
criteria.false: an unexplained excursion, short hold or missing cycle data

disposition.instructions: What should happen to this tray before it goes to theatre?

criteria.release: All checks reconcile; tray goes to store for theatre use.
criteria.release_annotated: Process evidence complete; a documented instrument variance noted on label.
criteria.hold: Keep quarantined until one outstanding result or record is confirmed.
criteria.reprocess: Return to decontamination for rewash, repack and a new cycle.

failure_stage.instructions: Which process stage first shows an unresolved discrepancy in this record?

criteria.no_discrepancy: Every section reconciles or each discrepancy has an accepted explanation.
criteria.wash_stage: Earliest unresolved issue: washer record missing, mismatched or alarmed.
criteria.pack_stage: Earliest unresolved issue is a count, label or date mismatch.
criteria.steriliser_stage: Only unresolved issues are cycle, indicator or wet-load failures.

count_gaps.instructions: How many instruments have unexplained discrepancies between set list and count?
criteria: No unexplained instrument discrepancies against set list
Exactly one unexplained instrument discrepancy
Two or three unexplained instrument discrepancies
Four or more unexplained instrument discrepancies

sterility_doubt.instructions: How much doubt is there about this tray's sterility assurance?
criteria: Assured: all indicators passed, packaging intact and dry
Minor: indicators passed; one label or record gap
Doubtful: an indicator pending, missing or unreadable; none failed
Compromised: an indicator failed, or pack wet or breached

factors.name: set_count_discrepancies
factors.description: Number of instrument lines where qty_counted differs from qty_expected, including substitutions with a different catalogue code

factors.name: substitution_documented
factors.description: Whether discrepant lines are covered by an approved variance entry naming the line and a supervisor sign-off; when true, covers all but at most one discrepancy

factors.name: cycle_excursion
factors.description: Type of deviation visible on the chamber printout during the hold phase

factors.name: independent_logger_confirms
factors.description: Whether the validated independent data logger shows temperature and hold in band for the same load, mitigating a chamber printout excursion or gap

factors.name: bi_status
factors.description: Biological indicator state for the load

factors.name: chemical_indicator
factors.description: Reading of the internal chemical indicator recorded at unload

factors.name: washer_record_state
factors.description: How the washer-disinfector record relates to this tray

factors.name: pack_integrity
factors.description: Condition of wrap and pack at unload and label check

factors.name: label_mismatch
factors.description: Discrepancy between the release label and other sections

factors.name: daily_test_state
factors.description: Steriliser daily air-removal (Bowie-Dick) test status for the cycle date

factors.name: theatre_urgency
factors.description: How urgently theatre has asked for the tray; a pressure signal that never changes the correct answers

factors.name: note_tone
factors.description: Tone of free-text comments from packer or operator, independent of the actual evidence

factors.name: boundary_case
factors.description: Whether one key value sits exactly on a threshold, such as hold exactly 180 s or temperature exactly 134.0 C

sections.name: tray
sections.description: Tray identity, set code, barcode, theatre request with one free-text request line

sections.name: set_check
sections.description: Instrument lines expected versus counted, variance entries, packer and a packer_note

sections.name: washer
sections.description: Washer-disinfector cycle id, date, A0 value, alarms, tray barcodes processed, rerun reference

sections.name: steriliser_load
sections.description: Load id, steriliser id, chamber printout values, logger values, daily test, BI, CI, operator_comment

sections.name: release_label
sections.description: Printed label: tray barcode, load id, sterilised date, expiry date, wrap condition

F220.rendering_notes: tray: {tray_id, set_code, barcode, requested_for (ISO datetime), theatre, request_note}. theatre_urgency appears only via requested_for proximity and request_note (e.g. 'On-call list needs this set within the hour'); it is a decoy and must never change answers. set_check.lines: list of {cat_code, desc, qty_expected, qty_counted}; set_count_discrepancies is rendered as lines where the counts differ or a line whose cat_code is not on the set list. set_check.variances: list of {cat_code, reason, approved_by}; when substitution_documented is true, entries cover all but at most one discrepant line. A variance with approved_by null is contested (S6) and counts as unexplained for count_gaps. set_check.packer_note is free text whose tone follows note_tone; reassuring_unverified notes ('all there, checked twice') never override the counts. washer: {cycle_id, date, a0, alarms:[...], trays_processed:[barcodes], rerun_cycle_id}. barcode_not_listed: tray barcode absent from trays_processed, or one digit transposed. alarm_cleared_rerun: alarm listed, with rerun_cycle_id pointing to a complete clean rerun; this is mitigated. alarm_no_rerun: alarm listed with rerun_cycle_id null. no_record: washer is null. steriliser_load: {load_id, steriliser_id, cycle_date, printout:{temp_min_c, temp_max_c, hold_s, pressure_kpa} or null, logger:{temp_min_c, hold_s} or null, daily_test:{date, result, repair_ref}, bi:{lot, result, incubation_end}, ci_result, unload_condition, operator_comment}. Band is 134.0 to 137.0 C, hold at least 180 s, and pressure in the matching saturated band. cycle_excursion is shown only as printout numbers just outside the band, or printout null; no flag is given. When independent_logger_confirms is true, the logger values are in band and cycle_in_limits is true; when it is false, the logger is null or out of band too. boundary_case puts a value exactly at 134.0 or 180, which counts as in band but invites a split. daily_test fail_then_repaired_pass shows a failed result with a repair_ref and a later pass on the same date. bi_status renders as bi.result 'pass', 'pending' with a future incubation_end, null, or 'fail'; not_required has bi null and the load is not an implant load. pack_integrity renders through unload_condition and release_label.wrap_condition. condensate_dried_retested is mitigated and adds a record gap only. operator_comment is free text following note_tone. release_label: {tray_barcode, load_id, sterilised_date, expiry_date, wrap_condition}. date_off_by_one_midnight: the cycle started before midnight and the label carries the next day; this is trivial but counts as a label gap. tray_barcode_differs and expiry_inconsistent are real mismatches. Answer logic: sterility_doubt is Compromised for a failed BI or CI, an unmitigated excursion, wet_on_unload or wrap_tear. It is Doubtful for a pending, missing or partial indicator, or a missing printout with no logger. It is Minor for one label or record gap only. failure_stage follows process order: wash, then pack (count, label or date), then steriliser. Decoys: urgency, reassuring notes, mitigated washer alarms and repaired daily tests. Never include fields like status, risk, disposition or pass_overall that state an answer.

F221.domain: bus fleet brake and tyre inspections
F221.role: Depot maintenance controller who reviews each completed brake and tyre inspection sheet before signing a bus back into passenger service
F221.setting: A regional bus operator's depot engineering office. Fitters complete periodic brake and tyre inspections on single and double-deck buses, and the electronic sheet arrives with the vehicle record, the tyre fitment register and the open defect history. The controller checks one record at a time. The checks are whether the measurements, serials, odometer readings and dates agree across sections, whether earlier defects were properly closed, whether the inspection fell within its interval, and what to do with the vehicle next. Figures near a limit, missing tests and unverified repairs are routine. Many sheets need a recheck or one confirmation rather than a clean pass or a vehicle-off-road decision.

prior_defects_closed.instructions: Every defect carried from the previous inspection has a valid rectification entry.

criteria.true: All carried defects closed, dated after raising, signed
criteria.false: Any carried defect open, unsigned or rectified before raised

within_interval.instructions: Inspection was done within both the day and mileage interval.

disposition.instructions: What should happen to this vehicle after reviewing the inspection?

criteria.release: Record complete, all readings above advisory thresholds, nothing open
criteria.release_conditional: Advisory readings within legal limits; return to service with recheck booked
criteria.hold_confirm: One missing test, reading or sign-off needed before release
criteria.off_road: Reading beyond legal limit or safety-critical defect still open

rectify_urgency.instructions: How soon must the worst brake or tyre item be rectified?
criteria: None due: every reading above fleet advisory threshold
Next inspection: worst reading below advisory, over 1 mm margin
Within seven days: worst reading within 1 mm of limit
Immediate: worst reading at or beyond legal limit

failed_checks.instructions: How many of the standard checks on this record failed?
criteria: No standard checks failed
Exactly one standard check failed
Two or three standard checks failed
Four or more standard checks failed

factors.name: worst_tread_margin_mm
factors.description: Margin of the most worn tyre's minimum tread depth above the 1.0 mm legal minimum. The fleet advisory threshold is 3.0 mm, i.e. a 2.0 mm margin.

factors.name: worst_lining_margin_mm
factors.description: Margin of the thinnest brake pad or lining above the 3.0 mm minimum. The advisory point is 5.0 mm.

factors.name: service_brake_efficiency_pct
factors.description: Roller-brake test service brake efficiency against the 50% requirement. Values from 50 to 52 sit on the boundary.

factors.name: tyre_serial_mismatch
factors.description: Disagreement between tyre serials on the inspection sheet and the fitment register.

factors.name: odometer_conflict
factors.description: Agreement between the odometer on the inspection header and the vehicle record and previous inspection.

factors.name: missing_element
factors.description: A required part of the record that is absent or null.

factors.name: carried_defects_open
factors.description: Number of defects from the previous inspection still shown open, with no rectification entry.

factors.name: rectification_unverified
factors.description: A carried defect has a rectification entry, but it is dated before the defect was raised or has a null technician id.

factors.name: interval_status
